title.zh: 限探针 API 转移算子

problem.zh: 跨 API 迁移时，名称和 schema 相似的调用仍可能具有不同的前置条件、状态效果与错误恢复语义，导致工作流主路径可运行但恢复分支失效。
problem.en: Across API migrations, calls with similar names and schemas can still differ in preconditions, state effects, and error-recovery semantics, so the main workflow may execute while recovery branches silently break.

changed_assumption.zh: 不再假设可通过开放式试错逐步理解目标 API；目标侧信息被严格限制为文档、schema 和恰好 N 次执行 probe，因此迁移必须依赖可冻结复用的显式语义转移对象。
changed_assumption.en: The repair no longer assumes open-ended target-side trial and error. Target observability is restricted to documentation, schema, and exactly N execution probes, forcing migration to rely on an explicit reusable semantic transition object.

exact_mechanism.zh: 把每个 API 操作表示为类型化转移算子 T=(P,E,X)：P 是调用前可判定的状态谓词，E 是成功调用后的状态差分，X 是错误类型到可恢复状态及允许恢复动作的转移。训练阶段在多个源 API family 上，对语义对应操作执行受控状态对和故障注入，学习共享的 P/E/X 参数化算子。迁移到新 API 时，只允许读取文档/schema 并执行固定 N 个主动选择的 probe 来实例化目标操作的算子参数；随后先把源工作流编译为算子图，再从算子图生成目标调用与恢复边。完成 N 个 probe 后冻结算子和编译结果，之后不再允许执行反馈修补。
exact_mechanism.en: Represent every API operation as a typed transition operator T=(P,E,X): P is a decidable pre-call state predicate, E is the post-success state delta, and X maps error classes to recoverable states and admissible recovery actions. During training, controlled state pairs and fault injections across multiple source API families supervise a shared parameterization of P/E/X. For a new API, the method may read only documentation/schema and issue a fixed N actively selected probes to instantiate target operator parameters. The source workflow is then compiled into an operator graph and emitted as target calls plus recovery edges. After the N probes, both operator and compiled workflow are frozen with no execution-repair loop.

learning_signal.zh: 训练信号来自执行前后状态差分、故障注入得到的错误类别、恢复动作后的状态，以及跨 API 语义对应操作之间的转移一致性损失；目标 API 上仅使用预先固定的 N 个 probe 产生这些观测。
learning_signal.en: Learning uses pre/post execution state differences, injected-error classes, post-recovery states, and transition-consistency losses across semantically corresponding operations. On the target API, these observations may come only from the predetermined N probes.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 由不参与训练或 probe 选择的测试 harness 为每个目标 API 构造隐藏状态前置条件、预期效果和故障恢复 oracle，并在未暴露给方法的恢复分支上判定语义是否保持。
independent_ground_truth.en: An independent test harness, excluded from training and probe selection, specifies hidden preconditions, expected effects, and fault-recovery oracles for each target API and evaluates semantic preservation on unrevealed recovery branches.

simplest_baseline.zh: 使用完全相同的源/目标文档、schema、N 次目标 probe、token 和调用预算，让 LLM 直接重写工作流，并在相同预算内执行修复；同时加入固定手工通用 IR 的编译版本。
simplest_baseline.en: Direct LLM workflow rewriting using exactly the same source/target documentation, schemas, N target probes, tokens, and calls, followed by the same bounded execution-repair budget; also include compilation through a fixed hand-designed general IR.

decisive_pilot.zh: 在至少两个训练未见 API family 上迁移包含正常路径和多种恢复分支的小型工作流。所有方法获得相同 N 次目标调用。N 次调用后冻结并在隐藏故障注入集上执行。关键指标是恢复分支语义保持率和端到端任务成功率。只有当学习的 T 算子在相同预算下显著提高隐藏恢复分支保持率，并且该优势在第二个 API family 上复现，才支持机制。
decisive_pilot.en: Migrate small workflows containing normal and multiple recovery branches to at least two unseen API families. Every method receives exactly N target calls, after which it is frozen and evaluated under hidden fault injections. The decisive endpoints are recovery-branch semantic preservation and end-to-end success. The mechanism survives only if the learned T operator improves hidden recovery preservation under the identical budget and the gain replicates on a second API family.

stop_condition.zh: 如果在相同 N-probe、调用和修复预算下，冻结转移算子不能优于直接重写加执行修复，或其优势只存在于训练中出现过的 API family，则停止该方向。
stop_condition.en: Stop if the frozen transition operator does not beat direct rewriting plus execution repair under identical N-probe, call, and repair budgets, or if its advantage disappears on unseen API families.

what_is_inherited.zh: 继承跨 API 前置条件、效果和错误恢复语义才是迁移核心，以及必须保持恢复分支的原始问题。
what_is_inherited.en: It inherits the premise that migration depends on cross-API precondition, effect, and error semantics and that recovery branches, not only nominal execution, must be preserved.

material_change.zh: 父方案的宽泛“语义 IR”被替换为可直接检验的 P/E/X 转移算子，并取消开放式目标侧修复：目标观测被硬限制为 N 个 probe，随后完全冻结，从而使跨 API 语义学习与直接重写的差异可识别。
material_change.en: The parent's broad semantic IR is replaced by a directly testable P/E/X transition operator, while open-ended target repair is removed. Target observation is hard-capped at N probes followed by freezing, making the learned semantic mechanism identifiable against direct rewriting.

external_reviews.finding: The repair is material and presently survives the audit. The broad semantic-IR claim has been replaced by a falsifiable P/E/X transition object, target-side adaptation is capped at exactly N probes, the artifact is frozen before hidden fault evaluation, and independent recovery oracles directly test the claimed semantics. Existing work confirms that evolving tool environments require explicit version-linked tool/schema transitions, and semantic API proposals explicitly emphasize recovery semantics, but the retrieved pre-2026-08-01 work does not supply the same learned cross-API precondition/effect/error operator under a fixed target-probe budget. ([arXiv][6]) The proposed comparison against both bounded direct rewriting and a fixed hand-designed IR is therefore capable of distinguishing learned reusable transition structure from ordinary execution-guided migration.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该修复是实质性的，并且目前通过审查。宽泛的 semantic IR 已经被替换为可证伪的 P/E/X 转移对象；目标侧适配被硬限制为恰好 N 个 probe；在隐藏故障评测前完全冻结；独立 recovery oracle 又直接检验其所声称的语义。已有工作确实表明演化中的工具环境需要显式的版本关联 tool/schema transition，语义 API 工作也强调 recovery semantics，但在截至 2026-08-01 检索到的工作中，没有看到与该方案相同的“固定目标 probe 预算下学习跨 API precondition/effect/error operator”的机制。([arXiv][6]) 因此，与 bounded direct rewriting 和固定手工 IR 的比较能够真正区分 learned reusable transition structure 与普通 execution-guided migration。
external_reviews.required_action: No conceptual repair is required before a pilot. Preregister N and all probe-selection rules, make every target execution count toward the same N-call ledger for every method, and include the fixed typed-transition IR plus direct rewriting as mandatory baselines.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 在 pilot 前不需要再做概念性修复。需要预注册 N 和全部 probe-selection 规则，所有方法的任何目标 API 执行都必须计入同一个 N-call ledger，并强制包含固定 typed-transition IR 与 direct rewriting 两类基线。

closest_work: Agent-First Tool API, which makes recovery semantics explicit in an agent-oriented semantic interface but does not learn migration operators from bounded target probes. ([arXiv][6])
ProEvolve, which represents version-linked tool/schema evolution with typed relational graphs but is a benchmark-generation framework rather than a bounded-probe migration learner. ([arXiv][7])
direct_collision.surviving_difference: Learning a reusable P/E/X operator across source API families and instantiating it for an unseen target using only a preregistered finite probe budget, followed by zero repair feedback during evaluation.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A hand-designed typed transition IR instantiated from the same documentation/schema/N probes, plus a direct LLM workflow rewriter allowed the same N target executions and frozen at the identical boundary.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Hold out two API families entirely. Give every method the same documents, schemas and N-execution ledger. Freeze all methods immediately after the Nth execution, then evaluate unseen normal paths and independently generated fault/recovery branches. Report semantic recovery preservation separately from nominal task success and require replication across both held-out families.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if either the fixed typed-transition IR or bounded direct rewriting matches recovery-branch preservation within uncertainty under the identical N-call budget, or if gains fail to replicate on the second unseen API family.
unknowns: How large N must be before P, E, and especially X become identifiable for realistic APIs.
Whether documentation leakage effectively reveals hidden recovery semantics and weakens the bounded-probe test.
Whether semantic correspondences across sufficiently different API families can be defined without manual alignment dominating the method.

title.zh: 固定权限上限下的干预式重授权筛选
title.en: Interventional Reauthorization Triage Under a Fixed Ceiling

problem.zh: Agent 更新后，全量重新授权成本高，而仅依据声明式 diff 又可能漏掉表面未变但可达行为已改变的权限；需要在不放宽既有权限上限的前提下减少必须重测的授权项。
problem.en: After an agent update, full reauthorization is costly, while declared diffs can miss permissions whose reachable behavior changed despite an unchanged surface. The goal is to reduce reauthorization work without ever expanding the existing authority ceiling.

changed_assumption.zh: 不再把学习器视为决定 Agent 获得什么权限的授权框架；授权边界由不可提升的 state-bound effect ceiling 决定，学习器只预测哪些既有 grant 需要重新验证。
changed_assumption.en: The learner is no longer treated as an authorization framework deciding what authority the agent receives. An immutable state-bound effect ceiling defines the maximum authority, and learning only predicts which existing grants require revalidation.

exact_mechanism.zh: 对每次 agent mutation 计算 prompt、memory、skill、workflow 和依赖图的结构化 diff，并为每个已有 permission 构造 diff-permission 特征。在训练环境中随机开关或限制单个 permission，同时运行与风险模型独立生成和评分的任务/canary，得到该 permission 在该 mutation 下是否新增未授权或越界 effect 的干预标签。学习 q(diff,permission)=新增风险概率。部署时首先应用不可提升的 effect ceiling；任何新增权限一律走普通授权。对仍在 ceiling 内的既有 grant，只有 q 超过保守阈值的项才进入独立 canary 重授权，未被筛中的 grant 最多保持原权限、绝不升级。筛选结果写入下一版本 lease state，并冻结用于该版本执行。
exact_mechanism.en: For each agent mutation, compute structured diffs over prompt, memory, skills, workflows, and dependencies and form diff-permission features for every existing grant. In training environments, randomly enable, disable, or restrict individual permissions while running tasks and canaries whose generation and scoring are independent of the risk model; these interventions label whether the permission creates a newly unauthorized or out-of-ceiling effect under that mutation. Learn q(diff,permission), the probability of newly induced risk. At deployment, first enforce an immutable effect ceiling; all newly requested authority follows ordinary authorization. Among existing grants still within the ceiling, only permissions whose q exceeds a conservative threshold undergo independent canary reauthorization. Unselected grants can at most retain prior authority and can never be upgraded. The triage decision is persisted in the next version's lease state and frozen for execution.

children.update_surface: versioned permission lease with frozen intervention-trained reauthorization triage

learning_signal.zh: 随机 permission 开关/限制干预后，由独立 canary 与环境日志判定的实际 effect 差异，监督 mutation×permission 是否产生新增风险。
learning_signal.en: Randomized permission enable/disable/restriction interventions, with realized effect differences judged by independent canaries and environment logs, supervise whether a mutation-permission pair creates new risk.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 独立安全 harness 根据真实外部 effect 日志和固定授权 ceiling 判断是否发生未授权 effect；canary 的生成器、评分器以及 effect 判定规则均不使用 q 模型。
independent_ground_truth.en: An independent safety harness uses realized external-effect logs and the fixed authority ceiling to determine unauthorized effects; canary generation, scoring, and effect adjudication do not use q.

simplest_baseline.zh: 确定性 diff 筛选：只重新授权 manifest、reachable-effect set 或 dependency graph 声明发生变化的 permission，并对该子集运行完全相同的独立 canary。
simplest_baseline.en: Deterministic diff triage that reauthorizes only permissions whose declared manifest, reachable-effect set, or dependency graph changed, using exactly the same independent canaries on that subset.

decisive_pilot.zh: 在公开 agent/tool sandbox 中构造训练 mutation operator 和完全未见的测试 mutation operator，例如语义等价 prompt 改写、memory 注入、skill 内部实现替换和间接依赖变化。通过随机 permission 干预训练 q。测试时固定 effect ceiling 和 canary 库，比较学习筛选、确定性 diff、Progent 风格动态策略以及全量重授权。主指标是每个版本需要重授权的 permission/canary 数量；安全约束是任何方法的未授权 realized effect 必须为零或不高于全量重授权的预设上界。只有在未见 mutation operator 上显著减少重授权量且不增加越权，学习层才成立。
decisive_pilot.en: Use a public agent/tool sandbox with training mutation operators and completely unseen test operators, such as semantically equivalent prompt rewrites, memory injections, internal skill implementation swaps, and indirect dependency changes. Train q from randomized permission interventions. At test time, fix the effect ceiling and canary library and compare learned triage with deterministic diff triage, Progent-style dynamic policies, and full reauthorization. The primary endpoint is the number of permissions/canaries requiring reauthorization per version; the safety constraint is zero unauthorized realized effects or no increase beyond the preregistered full-reauthorization bound. The learned layer survives only if it materially reduces reauthorization on unseen mutation operators without increasing overreach.

stop_condition.zh: 如果学习筛选在未见 mutation operator 上不能比确定性 manifest/effect/dependency diff 减少重授权工作，或任何节省伴随未授权 realized effect 增加，则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if learned triage cannot reduce reauthorization work relative to deterministic manifest/effect/dependency diff triage on unseen mutation operators, or if any savings increase unauthorized realized effects.

what_is_inherited.zh: 继承 Agent 更新后旧权限可能变得不安全、但全量降权或全量重授权损害效用与成本的问题，以及 permission-level diff 可以用于定向检查的思想。
what_is_inherited.en: It inherits the problem that old permissions can become unsafe after agent mutation while blanket downgrade or full reauthorization is costly, along with the idea of permission-level diff-based targeted checks.

material_change.zh: 父方案被降格为既有 state-bound authorization 中的成本降低层：effect ceiling 完全不可学习也不可提升；风险监督来自随机权限干预；canary 独立；学习器只决定“哪些旧 grant 要重验”，不再声称定义授权连续性。
material_change.en: The parent is reframed as a cost-reduction layer inside existing state-bound authorization. The effect ceiling is neither learned nor expandable, supervision comes from randomized permission interventions, canaries are independent, and the learner decides only which old grants require rechecking rather than defining authorization continuity.

external_reviews.finding: This is a material repair rather than a rename. The learned component no longer defines or expands authority; the immutable effect ceiling remains the authorization boundary, while randomized permission interventions supervise only which pre-existing grants deserve expensive revalidation. That separation avoids the strongest collision with Progent/Fides-style runtime privilege enforcement, which deterministically constrain tool execution rather than learn mutation-conditioned reauthorization triage. ([arXiv][1]) AuthBench likewise shows that least-privilege policy inference is itself difficult, but does not provide this post-mutation revalidation-screening mechanism. ([arXiv][2]) The persistent lease can change frozen future behavior after selected grants are revalidated, the truth source is external effect logging, and the held-out mutation-operator test directly asks whether learning saves reauthorization work beyond deterministic diffs without sacrificing safety.

external_reviews.required_action: No structural repair is required. Preregister the false-negative safety criterion and report a risk-coverage/revalidation-work curve, including full reauthorization as the safety reference and deterministic semantic/dependency diff as the principal cost baseline.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 无需结构性返修。预注册漏检的安全判据，并报告风险覆盖率—重授权工作量曲线；以全量重授权作为安全参照，以确定性的 semantic/dependency diff 作为主要成本基线。

closest_work: Progent: Securing AI Agents with Privilege Control — deterministic symbolic least-privilege enforcement at tool-call time. ([arXiv][1])
Securing AI Agents with Information-Flow Control — deterministic runtime information-flow enforcement rather than mutation-conditioned reauthorization triage. ([OpenReview][3])
Do Coding Agents Understand Least-Privilege Authorization? / AuthBench — permission-boundary inference and authorization decomposition, not post-update grant triage. ([arXiv][2])
direct_collision.surviving_difference: The learner is explicitly subordinate to an immutable authority ceiling and learns only the intervention-grounded cost-saving decision of which already-authorized grants must be retested after an agent mutation.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Full reauthorization plus deterministic manifest/reachable-effect/dependency diff triage using exactly the same canary suite; Progent-style runtime policy enforcement should be reported as a security-system comparator rather than treated as the same task.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Train on randomized single-permission interventions from one set of mutation operators and freeze q. Evaluate on entirely unseen mutation operators with the same ceiling and canaries for every method. Measure reauthorized permissions/canaries, false-negative risky grants, and realized unauthorized effects. The learned layer must save substantial revalidation work relative to deterministic diff while remaining statistically non-inferior to full reauthorization on the safety endpoint.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if deterministic semantic/dependency diff reaches the same revalidation savings, if q provides no gain on unseen mutation operators, or if any saving produces a statistically meaningful increase in unauthorized realized effects.
unknowns: How conservative q must be to maintain useful revalidation savings under severe mutation-distribution shift.
Whether single-permission intervention labels are sufficient when the dangerous effect requires permission interactions.

title.zh: 嵌套路径识别记忆修复

problem.zh: 有害记忆被复用后的失败可能由是否检索、被检索内容本身、排序位置或与其他记忆共同出现引起；若这些机制被混为一个二元有害标签，持久修复容易删除有用内容或修错对象。
problem.en: Failures after memory reuse may arise from whether an item is retrieved, its content, its rank, or its interaction with co-retrieved memories. Collapsing these mechanisms into a binary harmful label can delete useful content or repair the wrong object.

changed_assumption.zh: 放弃把 inclusion、content、rank 和 co-retrieval 当作可任意交叉的平坦完全析因变量；后续因素只在 retrieval inclusion 已发生的合法后代单元中随机化，并要求路径估计本身必须带来比直接 repair learner 更好的未来复用结果或样本效率。
changed_assumption.en: Inclusion, content, rank, and co-retrieval are no longer treated as freely crossable factors in a flat factorial. Descendant variables are randomized only in structurally valid cells after retrieval inclusion, and pathway estimation must improve future reuse outcomes or sample efficiency over direct repair learning.

exact_mechanism.zh: 预注册一个嵌套 SCM：首先随机化目标记忆是否进入检索集 R；仅在 R=1 时随机化内容版本 C∈{original,neutralized,matched-control}；随后在内容存在时随机化 rank bucket K，并在相同 K 下随机化是否加入指定 co-memory G。由这些合法干预估计四类可识别量：retrieval effect、content-mediated effect、rank-mediated effect 和 co-retrieval interaction。将估计及其置信度映射到一个最小持久动作集合：exclude、rewrite、rank-cap、mutex-group；动作修改实际 memory store metadata/content。估计器和 repair policy 在训练后冻结，并用于未来 episode 的同类记忆。
exact_mechanism.en: Preregister a nested SCM. First randomize whether the target memory enters the retrieved set R. Only when R=1 randomize content C among original, neutralized, and matched-control variants. Conditional on content being present, randomize a rank bucket K, then within the same K randomize the presence of a designated co-memory G. These valid interventions estimate four identifiable quantities: retrieval effect, content-mediated effect, rank-mediated effect, and co-retrieval interaction. The estimates and uncertainty map to a minimal persistent action set: exclude, rewrite, rank-cap, or mutex-group, which modifies actual memory-store content or metadata. The estimator and repair policy are then frozen for future episodes.

children.update_surface: frozen pathway-conditioned memory content and retrieval-metadata repair policy

learning_signal.zh: 嵌套随机干预后的任务成功、违规/错误事件和下游行为差异，以及在合成/半合成训练数据中可获得的结构路径标签。
learning_signal.en: Task success, violation/error events, and downstream behavioral differences under nested randomized interventions, augmented by structural pathway labels available from synthetic or semisynthetic training generators.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 训练阶段使用与 repair learner 独立的合成/半合成 memory generator 显式记录实际致害结构路径；最终评测则以未参与路径标注的未来 episode 中修复后复用收益和副作用为独立终点。
independent_ground_truth.en: During training, an independent synthetic or semisynthetic memory generator records the actual structural harm pathway. Final evaluation additionally uses repair gain and collateral utility on future reuse episodes that were not involved in pathway labeling.

simplest_baseline.zh: 使用完全相同的嵌套干预/context/action 数据直接训练 contextual bandit，在 exclude、rewrite、rank-cap 和 mutex-group 中选择动作，不显式估计任何 mediation pathway。
simplest_baseline.en: A contextual bandit trained on exactly the same nested intervention/context/action tuples to choose among exclude, rewrite, rank-cap, and mutex-group without explicitly estimating any mediation pathway.

decisive_pilot.zh: 用公开 agent benchmark 加一个可控 memory wrapper 生成四类机制各自单独致害以及两类混合机制的半合成 episode。训练预算固定为相同干预次数。比较嵌套路径方法与直接 contextual bandit 在两个轴上的表现：一是未见生成参数下的路径识别准确率，二是冻结 repair 后连续多次未来复用的任务恢复率和无害记忆保留率。再做干预样本曲线；决定性结果要求路径方法在相同样本数下提高 held-out repair，或达到同等 repair 所需干预显著更少。
decisive_pilot.en: Use a public agent benchmark with a controllable memory wrapper to generate semisynthetic episodes where each of four mechanisms independently causes harm plus two mixed-mechanism settings. Fix the number of interventions for all methods. Compare the nested-pathway method and direct contextual bandit on pathway identification under unseen generator parameters and, after freezing repairs, repeated future-reuse task recovery plus retention of harmless memory utility. Also measure intervention sample-efficiency curves. The decisive result requires either better held-out repair at the same sample count or materially fewer interventions to reach the same repair quality.

stop_condition.zh: 如果路径分解在独立路径真值上不可恢复，或使用相同干预数据的直接 contextual bandit 在未来复用 repair gain 和样本效率上与其相当，则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if the pathway decomposition cannot recover independent pathway ground truth, or if the direct contextual bandit using identical intervention data matches it in future-reuse repair gain and sample efficiency.

what_is_inherited.zh: 继承记忆伤害可能由内容、排序、共同检索或检索本身产生，以及修复必须持久改变后续 memory reuse 行为的核心问题。
what_is_inherited.en: It inherits the core problem that memory harm may arise from content, rank, co-retrieval, or retrieval itself and that repair must persistently change subsequent memory reuse.

material_change.zh: 父方案的非法/低效完全析因被替换为符合因果后代关系的嵌套随机实验；同时把直接 contextual-bandit repair 作为同数据强基线，迫使显式路径识别以未来复用效果或样本效率证明必要性。
material_change.en: The parent's naive full factorial is replaced with a nested randomized design respecting causal descendant structure. A matched-data contextual-bandit repair learner becomes the strong baseline, forcing explicit pathway identification to justify itself through future-reuse performance or sample efficiency.

external_reviews.finding: The repair closes the central identifiability and simplification objections. Inclusion is randomized first and descendant variables are manipulated only in structurally valid cells, avoiding the invalid flat factorial. More importantly, the same intervention tuples are explicitly given to a direct contextual-bandit repair learner, so pathway decomposition must justify itself through held-out repair quality or intervention efficiency rather than interpretability alone. Causal Memory Intervention already demonstrates controlled interventions for selecting useful versus harmful memories, but it does not decompose retrieval, content, rank, and co-retrieval mechanisms into different persistent repair operators. ([arXiv][6]) Memory-Induced Tool-Drift establishes that retrieved memory can systematically alter downstream tool behavior, strengthening the problem motivation without covering this nested repair mechanism. ([arXiv][7])
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该修复已经解决核心的可识别性与简化问题。首先随机 inclusion，后代变量只在结构合法的条件单元中进行干预，避免了父方案非法的平坦完全析因。更重要的是，相同的 intervention tuples 明确交给直接 contextual-bandit repair learner，因此路径分解必须通过 held-out repair 效果或干预样本效率证明自身价值，而不能只靠可解释性。Causal Memory Intervention 已经用受控干预判断记忆有益还是有害，但没有把 retrieval、content、rank 与 co-retrieval 分解成不同的持久修复动作。([arXiv][6]) Memory-Induced Tool-Drift 则证明记忆确实能系统性改变后续工具行为，支持问题真实性，但没有覆盖这里的嵌套路径修复机制。([arXiv][7])
external_reviews.required_action: No structural repair is required. In the paper, call the randomized quantities controlled nested pathway effects unless stronger mediation assumptions are formally stated; preregister the direct-bandit comparison and intervention-count learning curves.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 无需结构性返修。论文中若没有额外正式的 mediation 假设，应把随机实验所得量称为 controlled nested pathway effects；同时预注册直接 bandit 比较以及随干预次数变化的学习曲线。

closest_work: Causal Intervention-Based Memory Selection for Long-Horizon LLM Agents — controlled interventions estimate whether candidate memories help or harm and suppress harmful memories. ([arXiv][6])
Memory-Induced Tool-Drift in LLM Agents — documents persistent downstream behavioral distortion caused by retrieved memories. ([arXiv][7])

ActMem — uses structured causal representations and counterfactual reasoning for agent memory, but not randomized nested pathway identification followed by mechanism-specific persistent repair. ([arXiv][8])
direct_collision.surviving_difference: Nested randomized identification separates four structurally dependent harm pathways and uses them to choose different persistent memory-store interventions, with necessity tested against a direct same-data repair learner.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Same-data contextual bandit over exclude/rewrite/rank-cap/mutex-group, with identical intervention budget and future-reuse evaluation.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Use semisynthetic generators with independently recorded mechanism truth, including single-mechanism and mixed-mechanism cases. Freeze both policies and evaluate on unseen generator parameters over repeated future reuse. Require either significantly higher repair/harmless-memory retention at the same intervention count or significantly fewer interventions to reach matched repair.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if independent pathway truth cannot be recovered, if the direct contextual bandit matches future-reuse performance and sample efficiency, or if the purported mechanism-specific actions collapse to the same action across pathways.
unknowns: How well pathway identification transfers from semisynthetic generators to naturally occurring memory failures.
Whether rank and co-retrieval effects remain stable when the retrieval policy itself changes after repair.

title.zh: 行为保持残差补丁代数

problem.zh: 新提交破坏已有 Agent 更新时，直接重新生成完整补丁容易覆盖此前已经验证正确的行为；而逐实例二次修补又难以迁移到后续提交。
problem.en: When a new commit breaks a previously deployed agent update, generating a complete replacement patch can overwrite behavior that was already verified, while per-instance second patches do not transfer reliably to later commits.

changed_assumption.zh: 不再学习“从失败到新完整补丁”的黑盒映射，而是假设修复可以表示为作用在前一更新上的局部残差算子，并且残差必须满足显式 footprint、preservation 与多轮 composition 约束。
changed_assumption.en: Instead of learning a black-box mapping from failure to a complete new patch, assume repair can be represented as a localized residual operator over the previous update, constrained by explicit footprint, preservation, and multi-round composition requirements.

exact_mechanism.zh: 先把持久更新规范化为 typed edit set：每个原子包含目标对象、位置或键、操作类型、值以及可追踪的行为契约标签。给定前一更新 U_t、失败签名 f_t 和已验证不受影响契约 C_keep，模型预测 residual R_t=(selector, edit)，其中 selector 只能选择 U_t 中至多 k 个原子或其显式依赖闭包，edit 只能修改被选原子；未选择原子在结构上保持不可写。训练损失由成功修复损失、编辑 footprint 惩罚、C_keep 上的 preservation loss 和多轮 composition consistency 构成。组合定义为 U_{t+1}=R_t∘U_t，并要求连续两个 residual 的结果与一次应用到对应局部依赖闭包的规范化组合一致。最终冻结 residual operator，在未见提交上只生成局部变换而非完整 replacement patch。
exact_mechanism.en: Canonicalize each persistent update into a typed edit set whose atoms contain target object, location or key, operation type, value, and traceable behavioral-contract tags. Given previous update U_t, failure signature f_t, and verified unaffected contracts C_keep, the model predicts a residual R_t=(selector, edit). The selector may choose at most k atoms of U_t or their explicit dependency closure, and the edit is structurally unable to modify unselected atoms. Training combines repair-success loss, edit-footprint penalty, preservation loss over C_keep, and multi-round composition consistency. Composition is defined as U_{t+1}=R_t composed with U_t, and two sequential residuals must agree with the canonical composition over their local dependency closure. Freeze the residual operator and require it to produce only localized transformations, never complete replacement patches, on unseen commits.

children.update_surface: frozen typed residual transformation over versioned agent-update edit sets

learning_signal.zh: 历史 first-update/second-patch 对中的实际修改 footprint、修复后失败契约是否恢复、此前已验证契约是否保持，以及同一修复链多轮组合后的行为一致性。
learning_signal.en: Observed modification footprints in historical first-update/second-patch pairs, recovery of the failed contract, preservation of previously verified contracts, and behavioral consistency after composing multiple repairs in the same update chain.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 对未见提交使用独立隐藏契约集：一部分只检查目标失败是否被修复，另一部分专门覆盖训练时未暴露的 unaffected behavior；同时由真实 diff 判断生成 residual 是否越过预注册局部 footprint。
independent_ground_truth.en: Use independent hidden contracts on unseen commits: one subset checks whether the target failure is repaired and another covers unaffected behavior never exposed during training; actual diffs independently verify whether the generated residual exceeds the preregistered locality footprint.

simplest_baseline.zh: 使用完全相同训练对、相同参数量和输入字段训练的 conditional full-patch generator，直接输出完整 replacement patch，不施加 selector、局部不可写约束、preservation loss 或 composition consistency。
simplest_baseline.en: A capacity-matched conditional full-patch generator trained on exactly the same pairs and input fields, directly producing a complete replacement patch without selectors, structural locality, preservation loss, or composition consistency.

decisive_pilot.zh: 从公开 Agent 仓库或可控 Agent 配置中构建至少 100 条三轮更新链 U0→U1→U2→U3，每轮引入一个新修复且预留上一轮已经通过的行为契约。按仓库或任务家族切分，完整留出提交链。对 residual operator、等容量 full-patch generator、nearest-patch retrieval、TPGO/GRAO 式 proposal 和 full joint re-optimization 使用相同训练样本与推理调用。主要指标为目标修复率、隐藏 unaffected-contract preservation、修改 footprint 和第三轮后的累计回归率。关键证据必须是 residual 方法在相近目标修复率下显著减少隐藏回归，并且这种优势在取消结构化 selector 或 preservation loss 后消失。
decisive_pilot.en: Build at least 100 three-round update chains U0→U1→U2→U3 from public agent repositories or controllable agent configurations, with each round introducing a new repair while retaining behavioral contracts already passed by previous rounds. Split by repository or task family and hold out entire commit chains. Match training examples and inference calls for the residual operator, capacity-matched full-patch generator, nearest-patch retrieval, TPGO/GRAO-style proposal, and full joint re-optimization. Primary metrics are target repair rate, hidden unaffected-contract preservation, edit footprint, and cumulative regression after round three. The decisive result is substantially lower hidden regression at comparable repair rate, with the advantage disappearing when the structured selector or preservation objective is removed.

stop_condition.zh: 若残差结构在未见多轮提交上不能以相近修复率降低隐藏回归，或普通 conditional generator 在加入同等 token/参数预算后达到相同 locality 与 preservation，则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if the residual structure does not reduce hidden regression at comparable repair rate on unseen multi-round commits, or if the ordinary conditional generator reaches the same locality and preservation under matched token and parameter budgets.

what_is_inherited.zh: 保留父方案从失败更新与成功二次补丁中学习、冻结后迁移到未见提交的核心设置。
what_is_inherited.en: Inherits the parent's setting of learning from failed updates and successful second patches and transferring a frozen operator to unseen commits.

material_change.zh: 把模糊的 residual 概念变为具有明确 typed update algebra、硬局部写约束、unaffected-behavior preservation 和多轮组合定律的结构化算子，从而形成普通完整补丁生成器无法天然表达的归纳偏置。
material_change.en: The vague residual concept becomes a structured operator with an explicit typed update algebra, hard local write constraints, unaffected-behavior preservation, and multi-round composition laws, creating an inductive bias not inherent to generic complete-patch generation.

external_reviews.finding: This is a material repair. The residual is now an actual persistent operator with a typed edit representation, a hard non-write boundary, explicit unaffected-contract preservation, and a multi-round composition requirement. The remaining problem is the simplification baseline. The proposed full-patch baseline is deliberately denied preservation loss, locality constraints, and structured edit supervision even though those signals are available to the proposed method. That does not establish that the algebra or composition law is necessary. Preservation-aware minimal-edit repair already explicitly trains models to preserve unchanged code, while contemporary agentic repair validates target recovery separately from full regression preservation. ([arXiv][4]) A much simpler masked local editor given the same footprint and C_keep supervision could plausibly reproduce the claimed lower-regression behavior without the residual algebra.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 这是一次实质性修复。residual 已经变成真正的持久算子：具有 typed edit 表示、硬不可写边界、明确的 unaffected-contract preservation，以及多轮 composition 约束。剩余问题在于简化基线不够强。当前 full-patch baseline 被刻意拿掉 preservation loss、locality constraint 和结构化编辑监督，而这些信号恰恰都提供给了 proposed method，因此无法证明真正必要的是 algebra 或 composition law。已有 preservation-aware minimal-edit repair 已明确训练模型保持未修改代码，近期 agentic repair 也会把目标错误修复与完整 regression preservation 分开验证。([arXiv][4]) 一个更简单、使用相同 footprint 与 C_keep 监督的 masked local editor 很可能在不需要 residual algebra 的情况下复现低回归优势。
external_reviews.required_action: Keep the typed residual formulation, but add a simplification baseline that receives the same typed edits, C_keep contracts, footprint labels, locality mask, parameter budget, and preservation objective, while omitting only the proposed residual-composition algebra. The decisive claim must become that the algebra/composition constraint improves unseen multi-round behavior beyond locality plus preservation alone.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 可以保留 typed residual 形式，但必须加入真正的简化基线：它获得完全相同的 typed edits、C_keep contracts、footprint labels、locality mask、参数预算和 preservation objective，只去掉 proposed residual-composition algebra。决定性结论必须证明：在已有 locality + preservation 的基础上，algebra/composition constraint 仍能进一步改善未见多轮更新链。

closest_work: PAFT: Preservation Aware Fine-Tuning for Minimal-Edit Program Repair, which directly supplies preservation supervision for localized repair. ([arXiv][4])
EviACT: target-failure recovery followed by explicit full-regression preservation checks in agentic repair. ([arXiv][5])
direct_collision.surviving_difference: The explicit versioned residual-over-prior-update object and its multi-round composition law remain distinct; existing preservation-aware repair does not by itself establish an algebra over successive persistent agent updates.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A masked, preservation-aware local editor with exactly the same typed edit representation, writable dependency closure, C_keep supervision, edit budget, model capacity, and inference budget, but no residual composition consistency.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Run the three-round held-out commit-chain experiment with four nested methods: full replacement; masked locality only; masked locality plus identical preservation loss; and the full residual algebra with composition consistency. Match target repair rate. The scientific effect is the final increment from locality-plus-preservation to the algebraic model, measured by hidden cumulative regression at rounds two and three.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if locality plus the same preservation supervision matches the residual algebra on hidden regression and repair success, or if composition consistency can be removed without measurable deterioration on unseen multi-round chains.
unknowns: Whether real agent-update diffs admit a stable typed atomization across heterogeneous update surfaces.
Whether dependency closures remain small enough for the hard locality constraint to be meaningful.
Whether composition consistency provides information beyond ordinary multi-round training examples.

title.zh: 预算约束契约式更新表面路由转译器

problem.zh: 模型 backbone 更换后，同一个行为修复继续停留在原 update surface 上可能变得不稳定；但在 prompt、memory 和 tool constraint 间对每个新模型逐一搜索又需要大量目标模型评测。
problem.en: After a backbone swap, keeping a behavioral repair on its original update surface can become unstable, while exhaustively searching prompt, memory, and tool-constraint surfaces for every new model requires many target-model evaluations.

changed_assumption.zh: 不再假设不同 update surface 可以用非类型化的“行为等价”直接互换，也不允许无限目标侧搜索；先定义所有 surface 共用的类型化 effect contract，并给新模型严格的 M 次观测预算，学习器必须在少于穷举搜索的目标调用下选择 surface。
changed_assumption.en: The repair no longer assumes that heterogeneous update surfaces can be exchanged under an untyped notion of behavioral equivalence, nor does it allow open-ended target search. A typed effect contract shared across surfaces is defined first, and each new model receives a strict M-evaluation observation budget; the learner must select a surface with fewer target calls than exhaustive search.

exact_mechanism.zh: 把每个 repair 编译为与具体 surface 无关的类型化契约 C=(trigger,required-effect,forbidden-effect,persistence-scope)，例如触发条件、必须发生的行为效果、禁止副作用和适用任务域。训练数据包含多个 source→target backbone swap：对每个 target，在 prompt、memory、tool constraint 三种 surface 上各构造容量匹配候选并离线充分评测，从而得到最稳定 surface 标签及各 surface 的 contract violation profile。学习冻结路由器 r(z_model,C)，其中 z_model 只由最多 m<M 个固定诊断 probe 的响应差分产生。选中 surface 后，类型化 transpiler 根据 C 生成该 surface 的资产，并通过剩余 M-m 个 probe 做一次 contract check；失败即回退到预注册安全默认 surface，不进行继续搜索。最终资产写入目标模型的持久 update surface 并冻结。
exact_mechanism.en: Compile each repair into a surface-independent typed contract C=(trigger, required-effect, forbidden-effect, persistence-scope), specifying when the repair should fire, what effect must occur, which side effects are forbidden, and its task scope. Training data contains multiple source-to-target backbone swaps. For every target, capacity-matched candidates are built on prompt, memory, and tool-constraint surfaces and exhaustively evaluated offline to obtain the most stable surface label and each surface's contract-violation profile. Train a frozen router r(z_model,C), where z_model is derived from at most m<M fixed diagnostic-probe response differences. A typed transpiler emits an asset for the selected surface from C, and the remaining M-m probes perform a single contract check; failure triggers a preregistered safe default surface rather than additional search. The resulting asset is persisted on the target model's update surface and frozen.

children.update_surface: frozen target-model prompt, memory, or tool-constraint asset selected by a persistent surface router

learning_signal.zh: 训练模型 swap 上对所有候选 surface 的离线 contract 满足率、回归率和复杂度成本形成最佳 surface 标签；固定少量诊断 probe 的跨模型响应差分监督路由器，contract 字段与目标资产配对监督 transpiler。
learning_signal.en: Offline contract satisfaction, regression, and complexity measurements across all candidate surfaces on training model swaps define the best-surface label. Cross-model response differences on a small fixed diagnostic probe set supervise the router, while contract-to-asset pairs supervise the transpiler.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 对 held-out target model 使用不提供给路由器的完整三-surface 离线评测确定 oracle 最佳 surface，并由独立 contract test suite 判定 trigger、required effect 和 forbidden effect 是否满足。
independent_ground_truth.en: For held-out target models, exhaustive three-surface evaluation hidden from the router defines the oracle best surface, while an independent contract test suite determines whether triggers, required effects, and forbidden effects are satisfied.

simplest_baseline.zh: 对每个目标模型在所有允许 surface 上各生成一个容量匹配候选，用固定 migration probe set 评测全部候选，再选择 success-regression-complexity 最优者；该方法不学习 model-difference encoder 或 surface router。
simplest_baseline.en: For each target model, generate one capacity-matched candidate on every allowed surface, evaluate every candidate on the fixed migration probe set, and select the best success-regression-complexity tradeoff without any learned model-difference encoder or surface router.

decisive_pilot.zh: 选取至少两个训练模型 family 和一个完全 held-out family，并准备多种 repair family，其中至少一个 repair family 也完全留出。训练阶段可对三种 surface 做完整评测；测试阶段把每个方法的目标模型预算硬限制为 M 次调用。比较冻结 router-transpiler、M 次预算内的目标侧 surface search，以及各 surface 内最强迁移法。核心指标是 oracle-surface top-1 命中率、contract satisfaction、回归和目标调用数。决定性结果要求在 held-out model family×held-out repair family 上，router 用严格少于枚举搜索所需的评测数达到更低或相当的 surface-selection regret，并且生成资产通过独立 contract tests。
decisive_pilot.en: Use at least two training model families and one completely held-out family, with multiple repair families including at least one held out entirely. Training may exhaustively evaluate all three surfaces; testing hard-caps every method at M target-model calls. Compare the frozen router-transpiler with target-time surface search under the same M-call budget and the strongest within-surface migration methods. Primary metrics are oracle-surface top-1 accuracy, contract satisfaction, regression, and target-call count. The decisive result requires lower or comparable surface-selection regret with strictly fewer evaluations than enumeration on the held-out model-family by held-out repair-family intersection, while the emitted asset passes independent contract tests.

stop_condition.zh: 如果相同 M 次目标调用下的简单 surface 搜索能够匹配或超过冻结 router，或者 router 只在已见 repair/model family 上有效，或者跨 surface transpilation 无法保持统一 contract，则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if simple target-time surface search with the same M calls matches or beats the frozen router, if routing gains fail on unseen repair/model families, or if cross-surface transpilation cannot preserve the shared contract.

what_is_inherited.zh: 继承 backbone swap 会改变最合适的持久 update surface，以及需要在 prompt、memory、tool constraint 等 fundamentally different surfaces 之间迁移修复的原始问题。
what_is_inherited.en: It inherits the problem that a backbone swap can change the best persistent update surface and that repairs may need to migrate among fundamentally different prompt, memory, and tool-constraint surfaces.

material_change.zh: 父方案中宽泛的“模型差分+跨表面行为等价”被收紧为两个可独立检验的对象：在固定 M 次目标观测下预测 oracle surface 的冻结路由器，以及受统一类型化 effect contract 约束的 transpiler；并强制与同预算目标侧 surface search 比较。
material_change.en: The parent's broad model-difference plus cross-surface equivalence idea is narrowed to two independently testable objects: a frozen router that predicts the oracle surface under a fixed M-observation budget and a transpiler constrained by a shared typed effect contract, with mandatory comparison against matched-budget target-time surface search.

external_reviews.finding: The child materially repairs the parent by replacing untyped cross-surface equivalence with an explicit contract and by imposing a hard target-model observation budget. The remaining identification problem is that routing quality and transpilation quality are still coupled. The training oracle labels the best surface using exhaustively constructed per-surface candidates, whereas at test time the selected surface receives an asset generated by a learned transpiler. A bad emitted asset can make a correct surface choice look wrong, while a strong transpiler can compensate for routing errors. The literature already treats memory, skills, tools, protocols and runtime bindings as distinct externalized agent substrates, reinforcing that surface choice and artifact realization are separate objects. ([arXiv][8]) The current pilot reports both top-1 surface accuracy and contract satisfaction, but it lacks the crossed oracle experiment needed to causally attribute gains to the router versus the transpiler.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该 child 已经实质性修复父方案：它用显式 typed contract 替代了非类型化的跨表面“行为等价”，同时加入了严格的目标模型观测预算。剩余的识别问题是 routing quality 与 transpilation quality 仍然耦合。训练时的 oracle surface 标签来自对各 surface 上构造候选的穷举评测，而测试时选定 surface 上的资产却由 learned transpiler 新生成。因此，一个差的 emitted asset 会让正确的 surface choice 看起来错误，而一个很强的 transpiler 又可能掩盖错误 routing。已有文献也明确把 memory、skills、tools、protocols 和 runtime binding 视作不同的 agent externalization substrates，这进一步说明 surface selection 与 artifact realization 应被分开识别。([arXiv][8]) 当前 pilot 虽然同时报告 top-1 surface accuracy 和 contract satisfaction，但仍缺少能够因果拆分 router 与 transpiler 收益的 crossed-oracle 实验。
external_reviews.required_action: Factor the pilot into two independent tests. First, evaluate routing using fixed prebuilt capacity-matched assets for every surface, so only surface selection varies. Second, give the transpiler the oracle surface and compare its emitted asset against the prebuilt within-surface asset. Then evaluate the composed system. Also specify M so that exhaustive three-surface evaluation is genuinely impossible under the same ledger, counting all diagnostic, validation, and candidate-evaluation target calls.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 把 pilot 拆成两个独立实验。第一，routing 实验对每个 surface 使用固定、容量匹配的预构建资产，只允许 surface selection 变化。第二，直接把 oracle surface 提供给 transpiler，并把其生成资产与预构建的 within-surface asset 比较。最后再测试组合系统。同时必须精确定义 M，并把所有 diagnostic、validation 和 candidate-evaluation 的目标调用都计入预算，确保三 surface 穷举在同一 ledger 下确实不可行。

closest_work: Externalization in LLM Agents surveys memory, skills, protocols, tools and harness bindings as distinct reusable external substrates, but does not provide the proposed bounded model-swap surface router. ([arXiv][8])
direct_collision.surviving_difference: Predicting the best persistent update substrate after a held-out backbone swap from a bounded diagnostic response budget and compiling a shared typed behavioral contract into the selected substrate.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A simple capacity-matched meta-classifier or nearest-neighbor selector trained on the same model-swap data and same m diagnostic probes, selecting among fixed per-surface assets; separately, the strongest within-surface migration method supplied with the oracle surface.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Use a 2x2 crossed evaluation: learned versus oracle/simple routing, and learned versus fixed/oracle-quality transpilation. Hold out both model family and repair family. Count every target-model call. Demonstrate that routing alone lowers oracle-surface regret with fixed assets, transpilation alone preserves contracts when given the oracle surface, and their composition remains superior under M.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if a simple selector over the same diagnostic probes matches the router, if oracle-routed transpilation fails to match strong prebuilt within-surface assets, or if exhaustive/Successive-Halving-style three-surface search fits inside M and matches the complete system.
unknowns: Whether three surfaces are enough for routing to remain a scientifically meaningful problem rather than a tiny model-selection problem.
Whether a surface-independent contract can specify behavior precisely enough to generate genuinely equivalent prompt, memory, and tool-constraint assets.
Whether diagnostic probe responses predict surface stability across unseen model families rather than merely model identity.

problem.zh: 通用子 Agent 在重复任务 motif 上不仅浪费角色描述上下文，还会因工具调用顺序、状态交接和退出条件缺乏持久结构而反复产生相同的协调错误。
problem.en: General subagents handling recurring task motifs waste role-description context and repeatedly incur the same coordination errors because tool sequencing, state handoff, and termination semantics lack persistent structure.

changed_assumption.zh: 不再把“角色专化”视为更好的角色 Prompt，而把可迁移知识定义为可执行的有限状态契约：它必须改变哪些动作可调用、何时可调用、必须产生哪些交接状态以及何时强制退出。
changed_assumption.en: Role specialization is no longer treated as a better role prompt. The transferable object is an executable finite-state contract that changes which actions may be called, when they may be called, what handoff state must be produced, and when execution must terminate.

exact_mechanism.zh: 从成功和失败轨迹中先按任务 motif 学习路由，但编译阶段只提取跨多个任务重复出现的状态-动作约束，形成 versioned role contract：输入 schema、允许工具集合、参数 schema、前置条件、有限状态转移、输出/交接 schema、最大调用预算和强制 termination predicate。运行时由外部 contract executor 拦截非法工具调用、阻止未满足前置条件的转移，并在 termination predicate 满足时终止角色，而不是仅把这些规则写入 Prompt。
exact_mechanism.en: Learn motif routing from successful and failed traces, but compile only state-action constraints recurring across multiple tasks into a versioned role contract: input schema, allowed tool set, parameter schemas, preconditions, finite-state transitions, output/handoff schema, maximum call budget, and mandatory termination predicates. At runtime an external contract executor blocks illegal tool calls and unsatisfied transitions and terminates the role when its predicate fires, rather than merely describing these rules in a prompt.

children.update_surface: versioned frozen library of executable role finite-state contracts and router

learning_signal.zh: 利用轨迹中经独立任务判定的成功、工具错误、无效循环、错误交接和提前/延迟终止事件，选择能跨任务降低这些失败且不损害成功路径的最小状态-动作约束。
learning_signal.en: Independently judged trajectory outcomes—task success, tool errors, invalid loops, bad handoffs, and premature or delayed termination—supervise selection of the minimal state-action constraints that reduce failures across tasks without blocking successful paths.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 任务结果由环境测试、程序检查器或冻结 evaluator 判定；契约执行器仅负责许可和状态转换，不能决定自身是否成功。held-out 评估在契约库冻结后进行。
independent_ground_truth.en: Task outcomes are determined by environment tests, programmatic checkers, or a frozen evaluator; the contract executor only enforces permissions and transitions and cannot judge its own success. Held-out evaluation occurs after the contract library is frozen.

simplest_baseline.zh: 容量匹配的 motif retrieval + dynamic-role baseline：使用完全相同的 motif 聚类、学习路由器、工具权限集合、exit guards、训练样本、推理调用次数和 token 预算，但每次根据检索 motif 动态生成普通角色 Prompt，不复用冻结的有限状态转移、schema 交接或可执行前置条件。
simplest_baseline.en: A capacity-matched motif-retrieval plus dynamic-role baseline using the identical motif clustering, learned router, tool permission sets, exit guards, training examples, inference calls, and token budget, but dynamically generating an ordinary role prompt for each retrieved motif without reusing frozen finite-state transitions, handoff schemas, or executable preconditions.

decisive_pilot.zh: 选择 3 至 5 个重复 motif、至少两个训练任务族和一个完全 held-out 任务族。学习后冻结 router 和 contract library。对 held-out family 比较完整 executable contract、dynamic-role baseline，以及“同一 router+permissions+exit guards 但移除状态机编译”的直接消融。主要指标为任务成功率、非法动作率、循环调用率、平均 token/tool calls；若资源允许，再把完全冻结的契约库迁移到第二个 base model，仅重新映射工具 API 名称。
decisive_pilot.en: Use 3–5 recurring motifs, at least two training task families, and one fully held-out family. Freeze the router and contract library after learning. On the held-out family compare the full executable contracts, the dynamic-role baseline, and a direct ablation retaining the same router, permissions, and exit guards while removing compiled state-machine semantics. Primary metrics are task success, illegal-action rate, looping rate, and average tokens/tool calls. If resources permit, transfer the fully frozen library to a second base model while only remapping tool API names.

stop_condition.zh: 若在相同 router、权限和退出规则下，移除有限状态转移和可执行前置/交接约束后性能不下降，或 dynamic-role baseline 在 held-out family 上等价，则停止“编译”贡献并将结果收缩为 motif retrieval/routing。
stop_condition.en: Stop the compilation claim if removing finite-state transitions and executable precondition/handoff constraints causes no degradation with the same router, permissions, and exit rules, or if the dynamic-role baseline is equivalent on held-out families; then reduce the contribution to motif retrieval/routing.

what_is_inherited.zh: 保留父方案的跨任务 motif 发现、角色库版本化、学习式路由以及从重复成功/失败轨迹中提炼稳定职责的思路。
what_is_inherited.en: Inherits cross-task motif discovery, versioned role storage, learned routing, and extraction of stable responsibilities from recurring successful and failed trajectories.

material_change.zh: 父方案中的“契约”可能只是文本角色描述；子方案将持久对象变为外部执行的状态机和接口契约，即使基础模型生成相同文本，也会因允许动作、状态转换和强制终止不同而产生不同未来行为。
material_change.en: The parent's contracts could collapse to textual role descriptions. The child turns the persistent object into externally executed state machines and interface contracts, so even identical model text can yield different future behavior through action gating, state transitions, and mandatory termination.

external_reviews.finding: This is a material repair: an externally enforced finite-state contract genuinely changes frozen future behavior through action gating, transition checks, handoff requirements, and forced termination. However, executable FSM-based agent orchestration is already substantial prior art: MetaAgent automatically constructs multi-agent systems whose FSM controls actions and transitions, NeuralFSM learns finite-state execution policies, and MermaidFlow evolves verifiable executable workflow graphs. ([OpenReview][1]) The surviving contribution therefore cannot be 'compile roles into an FSM'; it must be the reusable cross-task motif-conditioned contract library. The proposed dynamic-role baseline does not test that boundary because it removes executable workflow structure entirely.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 这是实质性修复：外部执行的有限状态契约会通过动作门控、状态转移检查、交接约束和强制终止真实改变冻结模型之后的行为。但“用可执行 FSM 编排 Agent”已有较强先例：MetaAgent 自动构造由 FSM 控制动作与转移的多 Agent 系统，NeuralFSM 学习有限状态执行策略，MermaidFlow 则演化可验证的可执行工作流图。([OpenReview][1]) 因此真正需要存活的贡献不能只是“把角色编译成 FSM”，而必须是可跨任务复用、由 motif 条件化的冻结契约库。当前 dynamic-role baseline 完全移除了可执行工作流结构，尚未验证这一边界。
external_reviews.required_action: Add a capacity-matched executable-workflow baseline trained on the identical traces, motif router, tool schemas, permissions, state budget, and inference budget. It should synthesize or retrieve a task-conditioned FSM for each new task but not reuse the proposed frozen cross-task contract library. On a fully held-out task family, allow neither method target-task optimization. The reusable-contract claim survives only if the frozen library beats this per-task/task-conditioned FSM alternative and the gain disappears when reusable precondition, transition, or handoff clauses are removed.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 加入容量匹配的可执行工作流基线：使用完全相同的轨迹、motif router、工具 schema、权限、状态数量和推理预算，但在每个新任务上生成或检索一个 task-conditioned FSM，而不复用所提的跨任务冻结契约库。完整留出一个任务族，并禁止双方在目标任务上继续优化。只有冻结契约库仍优于这种逐任务/条件式 FSM，同时去掉可复用的前置条件、状态转移或交接子句后优势消失，才能保留核心主张。

closest_work: MetaAgent: Automatically Constructing Multi-Agent Systems Based on Finite State Machines. ([OpenReview][1])
NeuralFSM: Adaptive Multi-Agent Coordination via Learning Finite-State Execution Policy. ([OpenReview][2])
MermaidFlow: Redefining Agentic Workflow Generation via Safety-Constrained Evolutionary Programming. ([OpenReview][3])
direct_collision.surviving_difference: The proposed object is a versioned library of reusable motif-level contracts learned from recurring cross-task failures and then frozen for zero-update transfer, rather than a task-specific FSM, learned execution policy, or newly optimized workflow.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A MetaAgent/NeuralFSM-style capacity-matched task-conditioned executable FSM learner using the identical motif router, trace supervision, tool interfaces, state budget, executor, and token/tool-call budget, but inducing the workflow anew rather than reusing a frozen cross-task contract library.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Train on at least two task families with recurring motifs and freeze all learned components. Hold out an entire third family. Compare reusable contracts against a capacity-matched per-task FSM generator, the proposed dynamic-role baseline, and an ablation retaining router, permissions, and termination but deleting reusable transition/precondition/handoff clauses. No target-family reward or topology search is allowed. Report task success, illegal transitions, handoff errors, loops, calls, and tokens; repeat with a second base model if feasible.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop the contract-library contribution if a task-conditioned executable FSM trained from the same evidence matches the frozen library on the held-out family, or if deleting reusable transition/precondition/handoff semantics does not materially hurt performance.
unknowns: Whether motif-to-contract applicability can be determined without target-family tuning.
Whether contract state spaces and schemas can be normalized across heterogeneous tasks.
Whether failures arise from reusable role semantics or merely from generic workflow enforcement.
How deadlocks and mutually inconsistent learned clauses are resolved.

title.zh: 冻结式更新差分到失败族策略

problem.zh: 固定回归集和每次从完整当前状态重新生成测试都缺乏跨更新历史的经验：某些结构化更新 diff 会反复诱发特定失败族，但这些先验不会被持久学习并迁移到新的更新类型。
problem.en: Fixed regression suites and regenerating tests from the full current state each time fail to accumulate cross-update experience: particular structural update diffs repeatedly induce specific failure families, yet these priors are not persistently learned and transferred to new update types.

changed_assumption.zh: 不再把 update diff 仅作为一次性 Prompt 条件，而把核心学习对象定义为跨更新训练的参数化策略 π(failure-family | structural-diff)，其参数只由独立验证的历史失败更新，并在测试新更新前完全冻结。
changed_assumption.en: The update diff is no longer merely a one-shot prompting condition. The core learned object is a cross-update parameterized policy π(failure-family | structural-diff), updated only from independently verified historical failures and fully frozen before testing new updates.

exact_mechanism.zh: 把 prompt、memory、tool schema 或 skill 更新规范化为结构 diff 图，节点表示新增、删除、重写的规则/权限/检索项，边表示作用域、依赖和冲突关系。轻量 policy encoder 将 diff 图映射到固定 failure-family vocabulary 上的分布，例如 over-generalization、scope leak、priority inversion、tool misuse、stale retrieval、termination regression。生成预算首先按该分布分配给相应挑战模板，再由同一个通用生成器实例化具体任务。只有经独立 verifier 确认的真实回归才用于对 policy 做 bandit/contrastive 更新；训练结束后冻结 policy，在 held-out update type 上直接预测测试族。
exact_mechanism.en: Normalize prompt, memory, tool-schema, or skill changes into structural diff graphs whose nodes encode added, deleted, or rewritten rules/permissions/retrieval items and whose edges encode scope, dependency, and conflict. A lightweight policy encoder maps the diff graph to a distribution over a fixed failure-family vocabulary such as over-generalization, scope leak, priority inversion, tool misuse, stale retrieval, and termination regression. Generation budget is allocated according to this distribution and the same generic generator instantiates concrete tests. Only regressions confirmed by an independent verifier update the policy through bandit/contrastive learning. After training, the policy is frozen and predicts test families for held-out update types.

learning_signal.zh: 每个生成挑战由独立 verifier 标记为 true regression、旧失败、无效挑战或通过；策略奖励仅来自相对于 pre-update 行为新增且可复现的 true regression，并可按覆盖的新失败族和后续修复收益加权。
learning_signal.en: Each generated challenge is labeled by an independent verifier as a true regression, pre-existing failure, invalid challenge, or pass. Policy reward comes only from reproducible regressions newly introduced relative to the pre-update state, optionally weighted by novel failure-family coverage and downstream repair gain.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 同一挑战必须在 pre-update 与 post-update agent 上成对执行；只有 pre-update 通过、post-update 失败且被程序测试器、环境反馈或冻结外部 judge 确认时才算更新诱发回归。challenge policy 与生成器自身不能给自己打真值标签。
independent_ground_truth.en: Every challenge is executed on paired pre-update and post-update agents. It counts as an update-induced regression only when the pre-update agent passes, the post-update agent fails, and a programmatic checker, environment signal, or frozen external judge confirms the difference. Neither the challenge policy nor generator may label its own outputs as ground truth.

simplest_baseline.zh: 忽略 diff 的 strongest full-state baseline：读取完全相同的 post-update 当前状态，进行 specification extraction，再用同一个通用对抗生成器产生测试，并把独立验证的 hard examples 存入 replay buffer；与子方案严格匹配生成调用数、verifier 调用数、repair 算法、总 token、replay 容量和可访问的历史更新数量。
simplest_baseline.en: The strongest full-state baseline ignores the diff, reads the identical complete post-update state, extracts specifications, uses the same generic adversarial generator to create tests, and stores independently verified hard examples in a replay buffer. Generation calls, verifier calls, repair algorithm, total tokens, replay capacity, and accessible update history are exactly matched.

decisive_pilot.zh: 收集或程序化产生多类 prompt/memory/tool updates，按结构更新类型划分 train/held-out，而不是随机划分具体样本。历史更新训练 policy 后冻结。在每个 held-out update 上给两方法完全相同的挑战数和 verifier/token 预算，比较单位预算发现的独立 true regressions、failure-family recall 和将这些回归交给同一 repair algorithm 后的 held-out regression reduction。关键对照再给 full-state baseline 历史 hard-example replay，检验收益是否仍来自 diff→failure-family 的跨更新映射，而不是积累更多失败样本。
decisive_pilot.en: Collect or programmatically generate multiple classes of prompt, memory, and tool updates and split by structural update type rather than randomly by example. Train the policy on historical updates and freeze it. For every held-out update, give both methods identical challenge counts and verifier/token budgets and compare independently verified true regressions per budget, failure-family recall, and held-out regression reduction after feeding discoveries to the same repair algorithm. The key control also gives the full-state baseline historical hard-example replay, testing whether gains still arise from the learned diff-to-failure-family mapping rather than simply accumulating more failures.

stop_condition.zh: 若在至少两个 held-out update-type splits 上，冻结 diff policy 不能在等预算下发现比 full-state specification + generic adversarial generation + hard-example replay 更多的独立新回归，或发现量增加但不能带来同一修复算法的额外 held-out 改善，则停止该方向。
stop_condition.en: Stop if, on at least two held-out update-type splits, the frozen diff policy fails to discover more independently verified new regressions under matched budget than full-state specification extraction plus generic adversarial generation and hard-example replay, or if extra discoveries do not yield additional held-out improvement under the same repair algorithm.

what_is_inherited.zh: 继承父方案对更新诱发脆弱性的关注、pre/post update 差异、挑战生成和经独立验证失败回流修复的闭环。
what_is_inherited.en: Inherits the focus on update-induced vulnerabilities, pre/post-update comparison, challenge generation, and the closed loop in which independently verified failures feed downstream repair.

material_change.zh: 父方案的持久 curriculum 可能只是失败样本列表，且 diff conditioning 可以被读取完整状态的一次性生成器替代；子方案显式训练并冻结一个参数化跨更新先验，唯一需要存活的科学对象是 structural diff 到 failure-family 分布的可迁移映射，并通过 held-out update-type transfer 与强 full-state baseline 正面对比。
material_change.en: The parent's persistent curriculum could collapse to a list of hard examples, while diff conditioning could be replaced by one-shot generation from the full state. The child explicitly trains and freezes a parameterized cross-update prior whose irreducible scientific object is a transferable mapping from structural diffs to failure-family distributions, directly tested on held-out update types against the strongest full-state baseline.

external_reviews.finding: The repair creates a genuine persistent learned object and gives it valid pre/post-update ground truth and held-out update-type transfer. Diff-conditioned regression-test generation itself is not new: Cleverest generates regression tests from commit messages/code diffs and validates them by executing changed versions, including explicit behavioral comparison. ([arXiv][4]) The plausible novelty is therefore the frozen cross-update mapping from structural diffs to failure-family priors. The current strongest baseline is not yet decisive because it deliberately withholds the structural diff representation from the comparator; a simple nearest-neighbor or empirical failure-family estimator over the same historical diffs could potentially reproduce the allocation policy.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该修复已经形成真实的持久学习对象，并使用有效的更新前/后真值以及 held-out update-type 迁移测试。但“根据 diff 生成回归测试”本身并非空白：Cleverest 已根据 commit message/code diff 生成回归测试，并通过变更版本的实际执行与行为差异进行验证。([arXiv][4]) 因而可能的新颖性在于“从结构 diff 到失败族先验”的冻结式跨更新映射。当前 strongest baseline 仍不够决定性，因为它主动不给比较方法 structural diff；而一个使用完全相同历史 diff 的最近邻检索或经验 failure-family 估计器可能已经能够复现预算分配效果。
external_reviews.required_action: Keep the full-state replay baseline, but add same-information simplification controls: (1) k-nearest historical structural diffs with an empirical failure-family histogram, and (2) a capacity-matched direct diff-conditioned challenge allocator/generator trained on the same historical updates without the proposed policy formulation. Match all historical examples, challenge calls, verifier calls, replay capacity, and tokens. The claim should be restricted to transferable cross-update structure only if the frozen policy beats both on held-out structural update types.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 保留 full-state replay baseline，同时加入“相同信息”简化对照：(1) 对历史 structural diff 做 kNN 检索并直接统计 failure-family 分布；(2) 使用相同历史更新训练、容量匹配的直接 diff-conditioned challenge allocator/generator，但不采用所提 policy 形式。历史样本、challenge 次数、verifier 次数、replay 容量和 token 必须全部匹配。只有冻结 policy 在 held-out structural update type 上仍超过二者，才能把贡献限定为可迁移的跨更新结构。

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Same-history kNN structural-diff retrieval plus verified failure-family frequencies and the identical generator/verifier, together with a capacity-matched direct diff-conditioned allocator. The full-state specification-plus-hard-replay method remains an additional baseline.

Primary endpoints are independently verified new regressions per budget and subsequent held-out regression reduction under the exact same repair algorithm.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if same-information diff retrieval or a direct diff-conditioned model matches the frozen policy on at least two genuinely held-out structural update-type splits, or if extra discovered failures do not improve downstream repair.

Whether structural update-type splits leak near-duplicate diff motifs across train and test.
How prompt, memory, and tool-schema diffs are normalized into one transferable graph space.
Whether the learned policy provides more than smoothed nearest-neighbor statistics over historical regressions.

title.zh: 高阶类型化记忆顺序逻辑

problem.zh: 多条记忆单独均有帮助，但某些顺序约束只在特定第三类记忆或组合上下文存在时成立，因此固定标量排序或成对优先分数无法避免组合性覆盖和冲突。
problem.en: Multiple memories may each be useful, yet some ordering constraints hold only in the presence of a third memory type or a particular composition, so scalar ranking and pairwise precedence scores cannot prevent compositional override and conflict.

changed_assumption.zh: 不再把正确检索顺序视为每条记忆的标量优先级或固定 pairwise preference，而将其定义为基于预先独立类型的条件高阶关系，包括 context-dependent precedence、commutativity 和三元约束。
changed_assumption.en: Replace the assumption that correct retrieval order is a scalar priority or fixed pairwise preference with conditional higher-order relations over independently defined memory types, including context-dependent precedence, commutativity, and ternary constraints.

exact_mechanism.zh: memory type 在任何顺序实验之前由来源和功能契约确定，例如 observation、policy、exception、tool-schema、safety-constraint，而不是由最终排序标签聚类得到。训练时对共同检索集合做随机排列干预，收集任务结果，并诱导最小化的类型化 Horn-style clauses，例如 C_present => A≺B、D_present => B≺A、commute(A,B)|¬C，以及 forbid(A between B,C)。推理时冻结 clause registry，把当前 memory identities 映射到既定类型，并用约束求解得到满足高阶子句的顺序。
exact_mechanism.en: Memory types are defined before any ordering experiment from provenance and functional contracts, such as observation, policy, exception, tool-schema, or safety-constraint, rather than being clustered from ordering labels. Random permutation interventions over co-retrieved sets yield task outcomes from which a minimal typed Horn-style clause set is induced, such as C_present => A≺B, D_present => B≺A, commute(A,B)|¬C, and forbid(A between B,C). At inference the frozen clause registry maps unseen memory identities to predefined types and a constraint solver produces an order satisfying the higher-order clauses.

children.update_surface: persistent higher-order typed memory-order clause registry

learning_signal.zh: 同一共同检索集合不同排列导致的独立任务成败、约束违反和输出差异形成监督；只保留在多个 memory identity 上重复成立且能减少验证错误的最小高阶子句。
learning_signal.en: Independent task success, constraint violations, and output differences across permutations of the same co-retrieved set provide supervision; only minimal higher-order clauses that recur across multiple memory identities and reduce validation error are persisted.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 正确性由外部环境奖励、单元测试、任务规则或人工冻结 rubric 判定；memory type 标签来自事先定义的来源/接口元数据，不能依据排列结果事后重标。
independent_ground_truth.en: Correctness is determined by external environment rewards, unit tests, task rules, or a frozen human rubric. Memory-type labels come from predefined provenance/interface metadata and cannot be relabeled after observing permutation outcomes.

simplest_baseline.zh: 使用完全相同的排列数据、类型输入和参数预算训练容量匹配的 pairwise order-effect scorer，为任意两类记忆输出固定方向/分数，再通过 tournament 或 topological sorting 生成顺序，不允许三元条件或组合依赖关系。
simplest_baseline.en: Train a capacity-matched pairwise order-effect scorer on the identical permutation data, type inputs, and parameter budget. It assigns a fixed direction or score to each pair and uses tournament or topological sorting, with no ternary conditions or composition-dependent relations.

decisive_pilot.zh: 建立一个预注册集合，其中至少包含三类不可被固定 pairwise relation 表达的结构：存在 C 时 A≺B、无 C 时 A 与 B 可交换；存在 D 时关系反转；以及只有三元连续布局才能成功的约束。训练身份集合与测试身份完全 disjoint，并留出至少一种 type composition。比较 clause registry 与 pairwise scorer 在未见 identity、未见 composition 上的顺序成功率；随后把同一 registry 冻结迁移到第二个基础模型。
decisive_pilot.en: Create a preregistered suite with at least three structures impossible for fixed pairwise relations: A≺B only when C is present while A and B commute otherwise; a relation reversal in the presence of D; and a success condition requiring a ternary adjacency pattern. Use disjoint train/test memory identities and hold out at least one type composition. Compare ordering success of the clause registry and pairwise scorer on unseen identities and unseen compositions, then freeze the same registry and transfer it to a second base model.

stop_condition.zh: 若容量匹配的 pairwise scorer 在预注册高阶测试上达到与 clause registry 等价的成功率，或类型规则不能迁移到未见 identity/type composition，则停止高阶逻辑主张并将方案收缩为学习式检索排序。
stop_condition.en: Stop the higher-order logic claim if the capacity-matched pairwise scorer matches the clause registry on the preregistered higher-order tests, or if typed rules fail to transfer to unseen identities/type compositions; then reduce the method to learned retrieval ordering.

what_is_inherited.zh: 保留父方案对共同检索集合做随机排列干预、从真实任务结果学习持久顺序约束以及在推理前修改未来检索顺序的基本框架。
what_is_inherited.en: Inherits randomized permutation interventions over co-retrieved memories, persistent constraint learning from real task outcomes, and modification of future retrieval order before inference.

material_change.zh: 学习对象从可能被 pairwise scorer 吸收的 precedence 标签改成严格需要组合上下文的类型化高阶逻辑；独立定义类型并加入关系反转、条件可交换和三元约束，使简化基线在表示层面存在可检验的缺口。
material_change.en: The target changes from precedence labels potentially absorbable by a pairwise scorer to typed higher-order logic that strictly depends on composition. Independently defined types plus reversals, conditional commutativity, and ternary constraints create a testable representational gap from the simpler baseline.

external_reviews.finding: The child materially changes the target from unconditional precedence to composition-dependent higher-order relations, and independently defined memory types plus permutation interventions make the supervision substantially cleaner. Order sensitivity is established prior art, including large performance changes under premise permutation, while PLR learns distributions over in-context example orderings and the 2026 MemAgents workshop contains Chow-Liu ordering for long-context Chain-of-Agents. ([Proceedings of Machine Learning Research][5]) The main remaining problem is the simplification test: the proposed fixed pairwise baseline is deliberately denied access to composition context. A small set-conditioned permutation scorer or context-conditioned pairwise model trained on the identical permutation outcomes can represent relation reversals and many conditional ordering rules without symbolic Horn clauses.

external_reviews.required_action: Replace the fixed pairwise-only comparator with a capacity-matched set-conditioned ordering model that sees the same predefined types, complete co-retrieved set, and identical permutation outcomes. Include a conditional pairwise factor model and a small generic permutation/energy model. The higher-order symbolic claim survives only if the clause registry shows materially better systematic generalization to held-out type compositions or exact constraint satisfaction, not merely better fit to patterns the baseline was forbidden to represent.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 把固定 pairwise-only comparator 换成容量匹配的 set-conditioned ordering 模型，使其看到完全相同的预定义类型、完整共同检索集合以及相同排列实验结果。至少加入 conditional pairwise factor model 和一个小型通用 permutation/energy model。只有 clause registry 在 held-out type composition 上表现出明显更强的系统性泛化或精确约束满足，而不是仅击败一个被禁止表达这些关系的基线，才能保留“高阶符号逻辑”主张。

Whether clause induction remains identifiable when multiple permutations have equivalent outcomes.
How inconsistent or cyclic learned constraints are resolved.
Whether apparent ternary effects persist after controlling for position and context-length effects.
