Include a conditional pairwise factor model and a small generic permutation/energy model. The higher-order symbolic claim survives only if the clause registry shows materially better systematic generalization to held-out type compositions or exact constraint satisfaction, not merely better fit to patterns the baseline was forbidden to represent.
children.external_required_action_zh: 把固定 pairwise-only comparator 换成容量匹配的 set-conditioned ordering 模型，使其看到完全相同的预定义类型、完整共同检索集合以及相同排列实验结果。至少加入 conditional pairwise factor model 和一个小型通用 permutation/energy model。只有 clause registry 在 held-out type composition 上表现出明显更强的系统性泛化或精确约束满足，而不是仅击败一个被禁止表达这些关系的基线，才能保留“高阶符号逻辑”主张。

title.zh: 交互条件非线性更新逆算子

problem.zh: 多个单独有益的更新在组合后可能产生新的非加性回归，而撤销任意已有更新原子的子集都无法恢复目标行为，因此传统 subset rollback 会在修复失败与丢失收益之间二选一。
problem.en: Individually beneficial updates can create a new non-additive regression when combined, while reverting any subset of the stored update atoms cannot restore the desired behavior, forcing conventional subset rollback to choose between failed repair and lost benefits.

changed_assumption.zh: 不再假设有害效应位于已有 update-delta 原子的线性张成空间内。逆操作必须依据组合后的交互证据合成一个新的 residual repair direction，并以当前更新组合和失败上下文为条件。
changed_assumption.en: Remove the assumption that harmful effects lie in the linear span of stored update-delta atoms. The inverse must synthesize a new residual repair direction from interaction evidence, conditioned on the current update composition and failure context.

exact_mechanism.zh: 对历史更新组合执行单原子、成对和完整组合的部分回滚干预，计算组合效果相对于各原子效果之和的 interaction residual。训练一个小型条件 patch generator，以更新原子摘要、交互 residual、失败探针表示和保留行为约束为输入，输出固定低秩 repair adapter 的系数与新方向。训练时显式投影掉可由已存原子 delta 线性组合解释的分量，使生成器只学习 span 外 residual；生成的 patch 经安全门控后写入持久 inverse library，供同类未见更新组合直接调用。
exact_mechanism.en: Perform single-atom, pairwise, and full-composition partial rollback interventions on historical update combinations and compute interaction residuals relative to the sum of atomic effects. Train a small conditional patch generator taking update-atom summaries, interaction residuals, failure-probe representations, and preservation constraints to output coefficients and new directions for a fixed low-rank repair adapter. During training, explicitly project away components explainable by linear combinations of stored atom deltas so the generator learns only out-of-span residuals; validated patches are persisted in an inverse library for future unseen update combinations.

children.update_surface: persistent interaction-conditioned nonlinear inverse-patch generator and inverse library

learning_signal.zh: 信号来自部分回滚干预后的独立回归测试：最小化组合更新引入的失败，同时约束每个原更新带来的保留收益；额外监督是完整组合效应减去原子/线性组合预测后的非加性交互 residual。
learning_signal.en: Supervision comes from independent regression tests after partial rollback interventions: eliminate failures introduced by the composed update while preserving benefits of each original update. An additional target is the non-additive interaction residual after subtracting atomic or linear-combination predictions.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 使用冻结的任务测试集、程序验证器或与更新训练过程独立的人工 rubric 衡量回归和保留收益；逆生成器自身的 residual prediction 不作为修复成功真值。
independent_ground_truth.en: Regression and benefit preservation are measured by frozen task suites, programmatic verifiers, or human rubrics independent of update training; the inverter's own residual prediction is never treated as repair ground truth.

simplest_baseline.zh: oracle subset/linear rollback：给予基线完全相同的 update atoms 和部分干预数据，并允许其知道哪些原子与失败相关；在所有已存原子 delta 的任意子集及任意线性组合中搜索最优回滚，再给予与子方案相同参数量的非条件固定 residual adapter，但该 adapter 不接收交互状态或更新组合。
simplest_baseline.en: An oracle subset/linear rollback baseline receives the identical update atoms and partial-intervention data and may know which atoms are associated with the failure. It searches over any subset and any linear combination of stored atom deltas, then receives an equal-parameter unconditional residual adapter that is not conditioned on interaction state or update composition.

decisive_pilot.zh: 用公开小模型和 LoRA/adapter 更新构造至少 20 个耦合组合：每个单独更新改善自己的目标任务，但联合应用后在独立 regression set 上失败；通过离线搜索确认不存在任何 stored atom delta 子集或线性组合能够同时恢复回归并保留预注册比例的单项收益。随后在未见组合上比较 oracle linear rollback 与冻结 conditional inverter 的恢复率、保留收益和 patch norm。决定性结果是逆算子成功修复一类已被验证位于 stored-delta span 外的交互回归。
decisive_pilot.en: Using a public small model and LoRA/adapter updates, construct at least 20 coupled compositions where every individual update improves its own target task but their joint application fails an independent regression suite. Offline search must verify that no subset or linear combination of stored atom deltas can both fix the regression and preserve a preregistered fraction of individual gains. On unseen compositions compare oracle linear rollback with the frozen conditional inverter for repair rate, benefit preservation, and patch norm. The decisive result is successful repair of regressions verified to lie outside the stored-delta span.

stop_condition.zh: 若所有可复现回归都能被 oracle subset/linear rollback 修复，或 conditional inverter 在真正 span 外案例上不能比容量匹配 residual baseline 提高修复率，则停止该方向；这说明没有证据支持学习非线性逆算子的必要性。
stop_condition.en: Stop if all reproducible regressions can be repaired by oracle subset/linear rollback, or if the conditional inverter fails to outperform the capacity-matched residual baseline on verified out-of-span cases; then there is no evidence that a learned nonlinear inverse is necessary.

what_is_inherited.zh: 继承父方案的部分回滚干预、只抵消有害更新效应而保留有益部分的目标，以及把逆操作作为可复用持久对象的思路。
what_is_inherited.en: Inherits partial rollback interventions, the objective of canceling harmful update effects while preserving beneficial ones, and the idea of storing reusable inverse behavior as a persistent object.

material_change.zh: 父方案可被“识别有害原子并取负”完全替代；子方案把实验域限制到已有原子任意选择和线性组合都已证明不足的耦合更新，并要求学习一个依赖交互状态、能生成 span 外新修复方向的条件逆算子。
material_change.en: The parent could collapse to identifying harmful atoms and negating them. The child restricts the target regime to coupled updates where every subset and linear combination of stored atoms is demonstrably insufficient and requires an interaction-conditioned inverse that generates a new out-of-span repair direction.

external_reviews.finding: The child materially escapes the parent's trivial 'identify and negate the harmful atom' reduction by targeting coupled updates for which stored-delta combinations are insufficient. This sits close to a mature model-merging literature: Task Arithmetic edits models with task vectors, TIES explicitly resolves interference among merged task vectors, TATR targets knowledge conflict during task arithmetic, and LoRI targets cross-task interference in LoRA merging. ([OpenReview][8]) No direct collision found for a frozen interaction-conditioned inverse generator that synthesizes new repair directions. The remaining flaw is the baseline: the proposed generator is conditioned on update composition, residuals, and failure probes, while the equal-parameter residual baseline is deliberately unconditional. A generic conditional repair hypernetwork could therefore explain the gain without the proposed interaction-residual decomposition or span projection.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 子方案已经实质性摆脱父方案“找到有害原子然后取负”的简单化，因为它明确针对 stored-delta 任意组合都不足以修复的耦合更新。但该方向紧邻成熟的模型合并文献：Task Arithmetic 使用 task vector 编辑模型，TIES 专门处理 task-vector 合并干扰，TATR 处理 task arithmetic 中的 knowledge conflict，LoRI 则直接面向 LoRA 合并的跨任务干扰。([OpenReview][8]) 尚未发现与“冻结的、交互条件化、可生成新修复方向的 inverse generator”直接相同的工作。当前主要问题是基线不对称：子方法接收更新组合、interaction residual 和 failure probe，而同参数 residual baseline 却被限定为 unconditional，因此一个普通 conditional repair hypernetwork 就可能解释全部收益，而无需所提 residual 分解或 span projection。
external_reviews.required_action: Add a capacity-matched conditional patch generator that receives the identical update-atom summaries, failure probes, preservation constraints, and training interventions but does not receive explicit interaction residual targets and does not project away the stored-delta span. Also make 'out of span' operational: certify that no parameter patch inside the stored-delta span satisfies the preregistered regression-and-preservation constraints, rather than describing a behavioral residual itself as lying outside a parameter span.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 加入容量匹配的 conditional patch generator：它接收完全相同的 update-atom summary、failure probe、preservation constraint 和训练干预，但不给显式 interaction-residual target，也不执行 stored-delta span 投影。同时应把“span 外”定义成可验证条件：证明 stored-delta span 内不存在任何参数 patch 能同时满足预注册的回归修复与收益保持约束，而不是把行为层面的 residual 直接称为位于参数 span 外。

closest_work: Editing Models with Task Arithmetic. ([OpenReview][8])
TIES-Merging: Resolving Interference When Merging Models. ([OpenReview][9])
Task Arithmetic in Trust Region. ([OpenReview][10])
LoRI: Reducing Cross-Task Interference in Multi-Task Low-Rank Adaptation. ([OpenReview][11])
direct_collision.surviving_difference: Learning a reusable conditional inverse operator from rollback interventions and requiring it to synthesize a new repair direction when every admissible combination of stored update deltas fails the preservation-constrained repair objective.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Oracle in-span rollback/merging plus a capacity-matched conditional direct patch generator using the same atom summaries, failure probes, preservation objectives, interaction-training examples, and parameter budget but without explicit interaction-residual subtraction or span projection.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: First construct coupled LoRA compositions and numerically certify, within the finite stored-delta subspace, that no coefficient vector satisfies both regression recovery and preregistered benefit preservation. Split by update composition so test combinations are unseen. Freeze both generators and compare oracle in-span rollback, conditional direct repair, and the proposed residual-projected inverter with zero target-combination optimization. Report repair rate, retained gains, patch norm, and transfer across composition size.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if a generic conditional patch generator matches the inverter on certified no-in-span-solution cases, if the explicit residual/span-projection ablation causes no loss, or if reliable no-in-span-solution cases cannot be constructed.
unknowns: Whether a practical and sufficiently exhaustive certificate of no acceptable in-span patch is feasible.
Whether interaction residuals are stable across model checkpoints and update magnitudes.
Whether the inverse generator generalizes to larger or qualitatively new update compositions.
How much of the benefit comes from generic conditional meta-learning rather than inverse structure.

problem.zh: 长期自进化会积累大量边际行为效应近似相同的记忆，但这些记忆在共同检索时可能产生不同的协同、抵消或冲突效应，因此按单条效应去重会误删不可替代经验。
problem.en: Long-running evolution accumulates memories with nearly identical marginal behavioral effects, yet those memories can exhibit different synergy, cancellation, or conflict under joint retrieval, making entry-wise effect deduplication unsafe.

changed_assumption.zh: 不再假设记忆的可替代性可由单条记忆的边际效应向量决定；目标改为学习集合级交互效应等价，使两个候选记忆只有在其与相关上下文记忆共同检索时仍保持行为效应时才可互换。
changed_assumption.en: Replace the assumption that substitutability is determined by marginal effect vectors with group-level interaction-effect equivalence: two memories are interchangeable only if their effects remain equivalent when jointly retrieved with relevant contextual memories.

exact_mechanism.zh: 对频繁共同检索的二元和三元记忆组执行受控加入、删除和替换干预，记录跨任务行为差分。由单项效应中扣除可加部分后估计 pair/triple interaction residual，并学习一个稀疏类型化超图：节点为记忆，超边存储条件交互签名与适用域。压缩时仅对在边际效应和所有已识别交互超边上均等价的节点构造 quotient class；类内可保留代表项，但任何具有不可忽略交互残差的成员保持独立。
exact_mechanism.en: Run controlled add, delete, and substitute interventions on frequently co-retrieved memory pairs and triples and record cross-task behavioral deltas. Subtract additive marginal effects to estimate pair/triple interaction residuals, then learn a sparse typed hypergraph whose hyperedges store conditional interaction signatures and applicability domains. Compression forms quotient classes only for memories equivalent both marginally and on all identified interaction hyperedges; members with significant residual interactions remain distinct.

learning_signal.zh: 监督信号是联合检索干预前后的独立任务结果差分，以及观测联合效应与各成员边际效应之和之间的 interaction residual；只有跨重复任务稳定出现的残差才写入超边。
learning_signal.en: Supervision comes from independently measured task-outcome differences under joint-retrieval interventions and the interaction residual between observed joint effects and the sum of marginal effects; only residuals stable across repeated tasks are persisted as hyperedges.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 由冻结环境或任务测试器直接判断成功率、约束满足、错误类型等结果，不使用压缩器自身的相似度或预测分数作为真值；最终等价性由压缩前后在未参与建图的任务上的行为保持程度验证。
independent_ground_truth.en: A frozen environment or task checker directly evaluates success, constraint satisfaction, and failure type; the compactor's own similarity or predicted scores are never ground truth. Final equivalence is validated by behavioral preservation on tasks excluded from hypergraph construction.

simplest_baseline.zh: 使用完全相同的单条跨任务效应签名与适用掩码，固定阈值聚类后每簇保留一个 medoid，并维护可逆 alias table；不给基线任何显式组级交互对象。
simplest_baseline.en: Using exactly the same marginal cross-task effect signatures and applicability masks, cluster under a fixed threshold, retain one medoid per cluster, and maintain a reversible alias table, with no explicit group-interaction object.

decisive_pilot.zh: 构造或筛选至少 30 组三记忆集合，其中 A 与 B 的边际效应签名在阈值内不可区分，但在存在第三类记忆 C 时出现方向相反或幅度显著不同的联合效应。冻结两种压缩器，在未见任务和未见 memory identity 上比较联合检索后的行为保持率、错误合并率和压缩率。关键判据是：在压缩率匹配时，超图方法显著减少 medoid 基线对这些交互组的 false merge，同时在纯可加组上不牺牲压缩。
decisive_pilot.en: Construct or mine at least 30 three-memory sets where A and B have indistinguishable marginal signatures under the clustering threshold but exhibit opposite or substantially different joint effects in the presence of a third memory type C. Freeze both compactors and evaluate unseen tasks and unseen memory identities for joint-retrieval behavior preservation, false-merge rate, and compression. The decisive criterion is significantly fewer interaction-induced false merges than the medoid baseline at matched compression, without losing compression on additive groups.

stop_condition.zh: 若容量和压缩率匹配后，加入二元/三元交互对象不能在预注册的非加性交互集合上显著降低 false merge，或所有观测联合效应都可由边际效应加和解释，则停止该方向并收缩为基于干预效应的普通去重。
stop_condition.en: Stop if, at matched capacity and compression, pair/triple interaction objects do not significantly reduce false merges on the preregistered non-additive sets, or if observed joint effects are adequately explained by additive marginal effects; in that case reduce the contribution to intervention-effect-based deduplication.

what_is_inherited.zh: 保留父方案的跨任务行为干预、适用边界、可逆来源追踪以及以实测效应而非文本相似度判断记忆冗余的核心原则。
what_is_inherited.en: Inherits cross-task behavioral interventions, applicability boundaries, reversible provenance, and the principle of judging redundancy by measured effects rather than textual similarity.

material_change.zh: 学习对象从“单条效应向量的等价类”变为“带高阶交互残差的集合级等价关系”。因此代表项选择不再是核心贡献；真正不可约对象是能够阻止边际相似但联合行为不同的记忆被错误合并的持久交互超图。
material_change.en: The learned object changes from equivalence classes over individual effect vectors to a set-level equivalence relation containing higher-order interaction residuals. Representative selection is no longer the contribution; the irreducible object is the persistent interaction hypergraph that prevents merging memories with similar marginals but different joint behavior.

external_reviews.finding: The repair correctly attacks the parent's marginal-effect assumption: pair/triple add-delete-substitute interventions can expose memories that are marginally equivalent but jointly non-substitutable. Higher-order hypergraph memory is already explored—for example HGMem explicitly evolves hypergraph memory to capture high-order correlations—so the graph representation itself is not novel. ([OpenReview][12]) The proposed causal interaction quotient remains different, but two material issues remain. First, the medoid comparator is too weak: a simple interaction-aware merge veto or classifier using the same pair/triple intervention outcomes may preserve exactly the same memories without constructing quotient classes. Second, the pilot claims transfer to unseen memory identities even though the persistent hypergraph is identity-node based and no explicit transferable type-to-interaction predictor is specified.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该修复正确击中了父方案“边际效应决定可替代性”的假设：pair/triple 的加入、删除和替换干预能够识别“单独看等价、联合检索却不可替代”的记忆。高阶 hypergraph memory 本身已有研究，例如 HGMem 就明确让 hypergraph memory 演化出高阶相关关系，因此“使用超图”本身不能作为新颖点。([OpenReview][12]) 所提的因果 interaction quotient 仍有差异，但还剩两个实质问题。第一，medoid baseline 太弱：一个使用相同 pair/triple 干预结果的简单 interaction-aware merge veto/classifier 可能不建立 quotient class 就能保留完全相同的关键记忆。第二，pilot 要求迁移到 unseen memory identity，但持久超图以具体 memory identity 为节点，当前机制并没有明确给出可迁移的 type-to-interaction predictor。
external_reviews.required_action: Define the transfer mechanism for unseen identities explicitly, for example a frozen type-conditioned interaction-signature predictor whose inputs do not contain identity-specific training labels. Then compare the quotient hypergraph against an interaction-aware veto table/classifier using exactly the same pair/triple interventions, storage budget, and compression target. The quotient claim survives only if its typed interaction structure generalizes to new identities/compositions or yields a better compression-preservation frontier than the simpler veto.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 必须明确 unseen identity 的迁移机制，例如增加一个冻结的 type-conditioned interaction-signature predictor，且输入不能依赖训练期特定 identity 标签。随后使用完全相同的 pair/triple 干预、存储预算和压缩目标，将 quotient hypergraph 与简单 interaction-aware veto table/classifier 比较。只有类型化 interaction 结构能够泛化到新 identity/组合，或在相同压缩率下得到更好的行为保持前沿，quotient 主张才能成立。

closest_work: Improving Multi-step RAG with Hypergraph-based Memory / HGMem, which explicitly uses evolving hypergraph memory for high-order correlations. ([OpenReview][12])
direct_collision.surviving_difference: The hyperedges are estimated from controlled behavioral substitution interventions and are used to define safe compression equivalence, rather than merely representing high-order semantic or retrieval associations.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A same-data interaction-aware merge-veto classifier/table with matched storage and compression rate, plus the original marginal-effect medoid baseline. If unseen-identity transfer is claimed, both methods must receive the same predefined type metadata.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Construct non-additive triples with matched marginal signatures, but split both memory identities and at least one type composition between construction and evaluation. Freeze a clearly specified type-conditioned interaction predictor or registry before evaluation. Compare the quotient against marginal medoid compression and a same-intervention interaction-veto baseline at matched compression rates. Evaluation-only substitutions on unseen tasks provide behavior-preservation truth.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if a simple same-data interaction veto matches the quotient at the same compression rate, if the method cannot act on unseen identities without measuring their own interaction edges first, or if pair/triple residuals do not replicate across tasks.
unknowns: How unseen memory identities acquire interaction signatures without new construction-time interventions.
Whether typed applicability domains are learned or manually specified.
The scaling cost of discovering pairwise and ternary interactions in large memory banks.
Whether higher-order effects beyond triples make the proposed equivalence relation unstable.

children.external_finding_zh: 该修复正确击中了父方案“边际效应决定可替代性”的假设：pair/triple 的加入、删除和替换干预能够识别“单独看等价、联合检索却不可替代”的记忆。高阶 hypergraph memory 本身已有研究，例如 HGMem 就明确让 hypergraph memory 演化出高阶相关关系，因此“使用超图”本身不能作为新颖点。([OpenReview][12]) 所提的因果 interaction quotient 仍有差异，但还剩两个实质问题。第一，medoid baseline 太弱：一个使用相同 pair/triple 干预结果的简单 interaction-aware merge veto/classifier 可能不建立 quotient class 就能保留完全相同的关键记忆。第二，pilot 要求迁移到 unseen memory identity，但持久超图以具体 memory identity 为节点，当前机制并没有明确给出可迁移的 type-to-interaction predictor。
children.external_required_action: Define the transfer mechanism for unseen identities explicitly, for example a frozen type-conditioned interaction-signature predictor whose inputs do not contain identity-specific training labels. Then compare the quotient hypergraph against an interaction-aware veto table/classifier using exactly the same pair/triple interventions, storage budget, and compression target. The quotient claim survives only if its typed interaction structure generalizes to new identities/compositions or yields a better compression-preservation frontier than the simpler veto.
children.external_required_action_zh: 必须明确 unseen identity 的迁移机制，例如增加一个冻结的 type-conditioned interaction-signature predictor，且输入不能依赖训练期特定 identity 标签。随后使用完全相同的 pair/triple 干预、存储预算和压缩目标，将 quotient hypergraph 与简单 interaction-aware veto table/classifier 比较。只有类型化 interaction 结构能够泛化到新 identity/组合，或在相同压缩率下得到更好的行为保持前沿，quotient 主张才能成立。

title.zh: 干预式消息效应迁移器

problem.zh: 固定或直接优化的多 Agent 通信图容易把训练任务上的边效用当成可迁移规律，在任务结构改变后继续保留干扰边或删除必要的协同边。
problem.en: Fixed or directly optimized multi-agent communication graphs can mistake training-task edge utility for transferable structure, retaining interfering edges or pruning necessary cooperative edges when task structure changes.

changed_assumption.zh: 不再把最终通信图本身当作需要迁移的对象，而是假设可迁移对象是“在给定任务 motif 与邻近通信上下文下，一条边或一组边的干预效应”。
changed_assumption.en: The transferable object is no longer the final communication graph itself, but the intervention effect of an edge or small edge set conditioned on task motifs and local communication context.

exact_mechanism.zh: 先将任务表示为不包含答案的结构 motif 描述符，例如分解深度、信息源数量、顺序依赖、角色异质性和需要聚合的证据数。在训练任务上，对候选消息边执行配对干预：正常发送、mask、内容保持长度的无信息替换，以及选定二边联合 mask。利用这些反事实结果训练一个 edge-effect predictor，输入任务 motif、发送/接收角色、边位置及局部邻接上下文，输出该边存在对任务成功率、token 成本和错误传播风险的预测增量，并显式估计少量二边交互。训练后冻结预测器。面对完全未见任务，只进行一次前向预测并在固定边数/token 约束下构造图，不再用目标任务 reward 搜索拓扑。
exact_mechanism.en: Represent each task using answer-free structural motif descriptors such as decomposition depth, number of information sources, sequential dependencies, role heterogeneity, and evidence aggregation demand. On training tasks, perform paired interventions on candidate message edges: normal transmission, masking, length-matched noninformative replacement, and selected two-edge joint masks. Train an edge-effect predictor from these counterfactual outcomes. Given task motif, sender/receiver roles, graph position, and local adjacency context, it predicts the incremental effect of an edge on task success, token cost, and error-propagation risk, plus sparse pairwise interactions. Freeze the predictor after training. For a completely unseen task, construct a graph in one prediction pass under fixed edge-count and token constraints, without reward-based topology search on that target task.

learning_signal.zh: 同一任务实例和相同 Agent 输出条件下，消息边正常、mask、无信息替换及联合 mask 之间的配对成功差、错误传播差和 token 差。
learning_signal.en: Paired differences in task success, propagated error, and token usage between normal, masked, noninformatively replaced, and jointly masked message-edge interventions on matched task instances.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 训练期间从未出现的任务家族与 motif 组合；在这些任务上用额外、仅用于评测的边消融测得真实边效应，并用完整任务成功率验证冻结预测器构造的图。
independent_ground_truth.en: Task families and motif combinations never observed during fitting; evaluation-only edge interventions on those tasks provide measured edge effects, while end-task success evaluates graphs constructed by the frozen predictor.

simplest_baseline.zh: 容量匹配的 Adaptive-Graph-Pruning 式 task-edge score predictor：使用相同任务描述符和模型容量，但只从观察到的图性能或边使用统计学习每条边分数，不使用受控反事实干预或边交互标签。
simplest_baseline.en: A capacity-matched Adaptive-Graph-Pruning-style task-edge score predictor using the same task descriptors and model capacity, but learning edge scores only from observed graph performance or edge-use statistics, without controlled counterfactual interventions or edge-interaction labels.

decisive_pilot.zh: 选择至少三个可程序化多 Agent 基准家族，训练时完整留出一个任务家族以及若干 motif 组合。所有方法共享相同候选角色、最大边数、LLM 调用、token 和训练期图评估次数。比较冻结干预预测器、容量匹配 task-edge predictor、GPTSwarm、AgentPrune 和 Adaptive Graph Pruning。主要检验不是训练任务最优图，而是未见家族上的边效应符号准确率、pairwise interaction AUROC、零目标奖励搜索条件下的任务成功率。若干预模型只能在继续搜索目标图时获胜，则不算通过。
decisive_pilot.en: Use at least three programmable multi-agent benchmark families, holding out one entire family plus selected motif combinations during training. Match candidate roles, maximum edges, LLM calls, tokens, and training-time graph evaluations across methods. Compare the frozen intervention predictor against a capacity-matched task-edge predictor, GPTSwarm, AgentPrune, and Adaptive Graph Pruning. Primary tests are edge-effect sign accuracy, pairwise-interaction AUROC, and task success on the unseen family with zero target-task reward search. An advantage that appears only after further target-graph optimization does not count.

stop_condition.zh: 若冻结干预预测器在完全未见任务家族上不能同时超过容量匹配非干预 predictor 的边效应预测和最终成功率，或关闭二边交互建模后性能不下降，则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if the frozen intervention-trained predictor cannot outperform the capacity-matched noninterventional predictor on both edge-effect prediction and final success for a completely unseen task family, or if removing pairwise interaction modeling causes no degradation.

what_is_inherited.zh: 保留父方案关于通信干扰/冗余的真实问题、边 mask/替换干预以及跨未见任务冻结评测。
what_is_inherited.en: Inherits the real communication-interference problem, edge masking/replacement interventions, and frozen evaluation on unseen tasks.

material_change.zh: 持久对象从“被优化的通信拓扑”改成“由受控干预学习的因果边效应预测器”；测试期不再优化边，而是要求该冻结预测器零搜索地迁移到完全未见任务。
material_change.en: The persistent object changes from an optimized communication topology to a causal edge-effect predictor learned from controlled interventions; test-time edge optimization is removed and the frozen predictor must transfer zero-search to completely unseen tasks.

external_reviews.finding: This is a meaningful repair of the parent: the persistent object is now a frozen effect predictor rather than a topology optimized on the target task, and zero target-task reward search makes transfer falsifiable. Existing work already optimizes or predicts task-adaptive multi-agent communication graphs: GPTSwarm optimizes graph connectivity, G-Designer decodes task-specific communication topologies, and Adaptive Graph Pruning jointly adapts agents and edges. ([Proceedings of Machine Learning Research][13]) Counterfactual effect decomposition also establishes intervention-based causal analysis in multi-agent sequential systems, although not for transferable communication-graph construction. ([OpenReview][14]) The surviving idea is therefore credible, but the current simplification baseline is invalid for PASS: the proposed predictor receives paired interventional data while the comparator is restricted to observational graph-performance or edge-use statistics. A same-capacity predictor trained on the identical edge interventions could potentially reproduce the result without the claimed causal/pairwise machinery.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 这是对父方案有意义的修复：持久对象从目标任务上优化出的拓扑变成了冻结的 effect predictor，而且禁止目标任务 reward search，使迁移主张可以被证伪。已有工作已经能够优化或预测 task-adaptive 多 Agent 通信图：GPTSwarm 优化 graph connectivity，G-Designer 解码 task-specific communication topology，Adaptive Graph Pruning 同时自适应 Agent 数量和通信边。([Proceedings of Machine Learning Research][13]) 另外，已有多 Agent 顺序决策工作使用 counterfactual effect 做因果分解，但并不用于可迁移通信图构造。([OpenReview][14]) 因此剩余差异可信，但当前 simplification baseline 仍不满足 PASS：子方法获得配对干预数据，而比较方法被限制只能使用 observational graph performance/edge-use statistics。一个使用完全相同 edge intervention 数据训练的同容量预测器可能无需所称的因果/二边交互结构就复现效果。
external_reviews.required_action: Add an identical-data baseline: a capacity-matched additive task-conditioned edge-effect regressor trained on exactly the same normal/mask/replacement/joint-mask executions, task motifs, role descriptors, and token budget, but without explicit pairwise interaction factors or special causal decomposition. Keep AGP/G-Designer/GPTSwarm-style observational/topology baselines as secondary comparisons. The method passes only if pairwise/local-context effect structure improves zero-search held-out-family graph construction beyond the same-data additive predictor.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 加入“完全相同数据”的基线：容量匹配的 additive task-conditioned edge-effect regressor，训练时使用完全相同的 normal/mask/replacement/joint-mask 执行结果、task motif、角色描述和 token 预算，但不加入显式 pairwise interaction factor 或特殊因果分解。AGP/G-Designer/GPTSwarm 类 observational/topology 方法可继续作为次级对照。只有 pairwise/local-context effect 结构在零搜索 held-out family 上超过 same-data additive predictor，才能通过。

closest_work: GPTSwarm: Language Agents as Optimizable Graphs. ([Proceedings of Machine Learning Research][13])
G-Designer: Architecting Multi-agent Communication Topologies via Graph Neural Networks. ([Proceedings of Machine Learning Research][15])
Adaptive Graph Pruning for Multi-Agent Communication. ([arXiv][16])
Counterfactual Effect Decomposition in Multi-Agent Sequential Decision Making. ([OpenReview][14])
direct_collision.surviving_difference: Training a frozen motif-conditioned communication-edge effect model from controlled message interventions and requiring zero-reward-search transfer to an entirely unseen task family, rather than optimizing a graph for the target distribution.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A capacity-matched additive/context-conditioned edge-effect predictor trained on exactly the same paired interventions and descriptors, with the same training graph evaluations and graph-construction budget; GPTSwarm, G-Designer, AGP, and AgentPrune-style methods are secondary topology baselines.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Hold out one entire programmable benchmark family and selected motif compositions. Generate one shared intervention dataset on the training families. Train the proposed sparse pairwise-interaction predictor and a same-capacity additive edge predictor on that exact dataset. Freeze both. On the held-out family allow zero topology reward search; use evaluation-only edge interventions to measure effect-sign accuracy and pairwise-interaction truth, then compare final success under identical edge/token constraints.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if the same-intervention additive predictor matches final held-out-family success, if removing pairwise interactions causes no degradation, or if gains require any target-task topology search or reward feedback.
unknowns: Whether masking an upstream edge should be interpreted as a total causal effect through all downstream message changes or a direct edge effect.
Whether answer-free motif descriptors leak benchmark-family identity or other shortcuts.
How sparse two-edge interactions are selected without biasing evaluation toward training motifs.
Whether one-pass graph construction remains tractable when predicted pairwise interactions make edge selection combinatorial.

title.zh: 潜在效应跨表面转译器

problem.zh: 部署环境可能禁止原修复所在的 Prompt、记忆、技能或工作流表面，因此系统需要把已经有效的持久修复迁移到另一种更新表面，同时保持原修复效果并避免新回归。
problem.en: A deployment may forbid the prompt, memory, skill, or workflow surface where a successful repair was originally stored, requiring the persistent repair to move to another surface while preserving its effect and avoiding new regressions.

changed_assumption.zh: 不再直接学习 source asset 到 target asset 的表面重写，而是假设不同更新表面共享一个可学习的 surface-invariant behavioral effect space；转译需要先恢复 effect，再由目标表面条件化 decoder 实现该 effect。
changed_assumption.en: Instead of directly learning source-asset to target-asset rewriting, assume different adaptation surfaces share a learnable surface-invariant behavioral-effect space; translation must first recover the effect and then realize it through a target-surface-conditioned decoder.

exact_mechanism.zh: 对训练期已有的行为等价跨表面修复组，分别执行一组训练 behavioral probes，得到每个修复的 effect signature：包括目标行为变化、受保护行为变化和触发条件变化。训练 source encoder 将任意表面资产及其训练 probe signature 映射到潜变量 z_effect；使用跨表面对比/循环一致性，使行为等价的不同表面修复共享 z_effect，同时分离表面格式特征。每个目标表面共享一个 typed effect-to-update decoder，其输入仅为 z_effect、目标表面 schema 和容量约束。训练结束后冻结 encoder/decoder。评测时完整留出有向 surface pair A→B；给定 A 上的源修复，不提供任何 A→B 示例，只通过冻结 encoder 得到 z_effect，再生成 B 资产。评测使用从未参与训练或选择的 hidden contracts。
exact_mechanism.en: For behavior-equivalent cross-surface repair groups available during training, execute a training suite of behavioral probes to obtain an effect signature covering target-behavior changes, protected-behavior changes, and triggering-condition changes. Train a source encoder to map an asset from any surface plus its training probe signature into a latent z_effect. Cross-surface contrastive and cycle-consistency objectives force behavior-equivalent repairs from different surfaces to share z_effect while separating surface-format features. A typed effect-to-update decoder for each target surface receives only z_effect, the target schema, and capacity constraints. Freeze all encoders and decoders after training. At evaluation, hold out an entire directed surface pair A→B; given a repair on A, provide no A→B exemplars and generate the B asset only through the frozen effect representation. Evaluation uses hidden contracts never used for fitting or model selection.

children.update_surface: frozen surface-invariant behavioral-effect encoder and typed target-surface decoders

learning_signal.zh: 训练 behavioral probes 上的目标效应向量与回归效应向量、跨表面已知等价组标签、潜在 effect 一致性以及 decoder 生成资产后的训练契约执行结果。
learning_signal.en: Target-effect and regression-effect vectors from training behavioral probes, known cross-surface equivalence-group labels, latent-effect consistency, and training-contract execution results of assets emitted by the decoders.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 为每个 held-out directed surface pair 预先封存一组 hidden behavioral contracts，包括目标修复行为与未受影响行为；这些 contracts 不进入 effect encoder、decoder 训练、超参选择或 early stopping。
independent_ground_truth.en: For every held-out directed surface pair, pre-seal hidden behavioral contracts covering both repaired behavior and unaffected behavior. These contracts are excluded from effect-encoder training, decoder training, hyperparameter selection, and early stopping.

simplest_baseline.zh: SkillIR 式固定 canonical IR 加手写 target emitter：源修复先映射到人工定义的统一 IR，再用每个表面的确定性适配器生成目标资产；使用完全相同的模型调用、token 和目标表面容量。
simplest_baseline.en: A SkillIR-style fixed canonical IR with hand-written target emitters: map the source repair into a manually specified common IR and use deterministic per-surface adapters to emit the target asset, under identical model calls, tokens, and target-surface capacity.

decisive_pilot.zh: 使用四种表面 Prompt、memory、skill、workflow，建立至少 6 个训练有向 pair，并完整留出至少 4 个有向 pair，特别保证某个目标表面在训练中出现过但从未与该源表面配对。所有方法获得相同源修复、训练 contracts、调用与目标容量。比较 latent-effect translator、source-conditioned target rewrite、固定 IR + emitter。主要指标为 hidden contract 上目标修复通过率、protected behavior 回归率和 held-out pair 的双向 effect distance。只有当 latent-effect 方法在没有 target-pair exemplar 的情况下优于两个 baseline，且优势集中在训练中未见的有向 pair，才支持该假设。
decisive_pilot.en: Use four surfaces—prompt, memory, skill, and workflow—with at least six directed pairs for training and at least four directed pairs held out entirely. Ensure a target surface appears during training but is never paired with the held-out source surface. Give all methods the same source repair, training contracts, calls, and target capacity. Compare the latent-effect translator, source-conditioned target rewriting, and fixed IR plus emitter. Primary metrics are target-repair pass rate on hidden contracts, protected-behavior regression, and bidirectional effect distance on held-out pairs. The hypothesis survives only if the latent-effect method beats both baselines without any target-pair exemplar, with the advantage concentrated on unseen directed pairs.

stop_condition.zh: 若固定 IR + 手写 emitter 或容量匹配 source-conditioned rewrite 在完整留出的有向 surface pairs 上达到等价 hidden-contract 保真度，或 learned z_effect 不能比表面格式特征更好预测跨表面行为等价性，则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if fixed IR plus hand-written emitters or a capacity-matched source-conditioned rewriter achieves equivalent hidden-contract fidelity on fully held-out directed surface pairs, or if learned z_effect does not predict cross-surface behavioral equivalence better than surface-format features.

what_is_inherited.zh: 保留父方案跨 Prompt、memory、skill、workflow 迁移持久修复以及以行为等价和回归测试验证转译的目标。
what_is_inherited.en: Inherits the parent's goal of moving persistent repairs across prompt, memory, skill, and workflow surfaces and validating translation through behavioral equivalence and regression tests.

material_change.zh: 从直接跨表面 asset rewrite 改成明确的 surface-invariant effect 表示学习，并通过完整留出有向 surface pair 与独立 hidden contracts 排除记忆 target-pair 映射；同时把最强简单方法固定为 canonical IR + hand-written emitters。
material_change.en: The method changes from direct cross-surface asset rewriting to explicit learning of a surface-invariant effect representation, with entire directed surface pairs and independent hidden contracts held out to rule out memorized target-pair mappings; the strongest simple comparator is fixed as canonical IR plus hand-written emitters.

external_reviews.finding: The child directly implements the important parent repair: an explicit effect representation is learned, whole directed surface pairs are held out, hidden contracts are separated from training, and fixed-IR plus source-conditioned rewriting baselines are included. This is meaningfully beyond PromptBridge's cross-model prompt mapping and MASA's model-conditioned skill rewriting, both of which operate on narrower adaptation objects. ([arXiv][4]) One material simplification remains, however. The encoder is given an already-observed behavioral probe signature containing target changes, protected-behavior changes, and trigger changes. A direct probe-signature-to-target-surface decoder can therefore receive essentially the same behavioral object without learning z_effect, making the claimed necessity of the latent invariant representation untested.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 子方案已经直接落实父方案最重要的返修要求：显式学习 effect representation，完整留出有向 surface pair，将 hidden contracts 与训练分离，并加入固定 IR 和 source-conditioned rewrite 基线。相较 PromptBridge 的跨模型 prompt mapping 与 MASA 的 model-conditioned skill rewrite，这里的迁移对象也更宽。([arXiv][4]) 但仍剩一个实质性的简化漏洞：encoder 已经获得包含目标行为变化、受保护行为变化和触发变化的 behavioral probe signature。于是，一个直接从 probe signature 到目标 surface 的 decoder 可以获得几乎相同的行为对象而完全不学习 z_effect，因此 latent invariant representation 的必要性尚未被证明。
external_reviews.required_action: Add a capacity-matched direct effect-signature baseline that receives exactly the same source-side probe signature, target schema, target capacity, calls, and tokens, but no latent contrastive/cycle objective. Also cost the source-side probe execution identically across methods. PASS only if z_effect improves fully held-out directed-pair fidelity beyond this baseline and the fixed canonical IR.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 加入容量匹配的直接 effect-signature 基线：它获得完全相同的源侧 probe signature、目标 schema、目标容量、调用次数和 token，但不使用 latent contrastive/cycle objective。同时所有方法必须计入完全相同的源侧 probe 执行成本。只有 z_effect 在完整留出的有向 pair 上同时超过该基线和固定 canonical IR，才能 PASS。

closest_work: PromptBridge: Cross-Model Prompt Transfer for Large Language Models — learns mappings between prompts for model switches. ([arXiv][4])
MASA: Model-Aware Skill Alignment — learns a model-conditioned skill rewriter from skill-evolution trajectories and generalizes to unseen tasks/environments. ([arXiv][5])
direct_collision.surviving_difference: The proposed thesis concerns a shared behavioral-effect variable spanning heterogeneous persistent update surfaces and zero-shot transfer across entirely unseen directed surface pairs, rather than prompt-only or skill-only model adaptation.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Direct behavioral-effect-signature-to-target decoder with the same target decoder capacity and observations, followed by fixed canonical IR plus hand-written emitters and a source-conditioned target rewriter.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Hold out complete directed surface pairs. Supply every method the identical source asset, identical source behavioral probes/signature, target schema, and target capacity. Compare hidden-contract repair fidelity and protected-behavior regressions. Then replace z_effect with the raw probe signature while keeping the decoder unchanged; the latent representation must retain a significant advantage specifically on unseen pairs.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if the raw effect-signature decoder or fixed canonical IR matches latent translation on hidden contracts, or if removing contrastive/cycle learning leaves held-out-pair performance unchanged.
unknowns: Whether the proposed probe signature is already sufficiently complete to function as the canonical effect representation.
Whether source-side behavioral probing is feasible for every surface under the intended deployment constraints.

children.external_finding: The child directly implements the important parent repair: an explicit effect representation is learned, whole directed surface pairs are held out, hidden contracts are separated from training, and fixed-IR plus source-conditioned rewriting baselines are included. This is meaningfully beyond PromptBridge's cross-model prompt mapping and MASA's model-conditioned skill rewriting, both of which operate on narrower adaptation objects. ([arXiv][4]) One material simplification remains, however. The encoder is given an already-observed behavioral probe signature containing target changes, protected-behavior changes, and trigger changes. A direct probe-signature-to-target-surface decoder can therefore receive essentially the same behavioral object without learning z_effect, making the claimed necessity of the latent invariant representation untested.
children.external_finding_zh: 子方案已经直接落实父方案最重要的返修要求：显式学习 effect representation，完整留出有向 surface pair，将 hidden contracts 与训练分离，并加入固定 IR 和 source-conditioned rewrite 基线。相较 PromptBridge 的跨模型 prompt mapping 与 MASA 的 model-conditioned skill rewrite，这里的迁移对象也更宽。([arXiv][4]) 但仍剩一个实质性的简化漏洞：encoder 已经获得包含目标行为变化、受保护行为变化和触发变化的 behavioral probe signature。于是，一个直接从 probe signature 到目标 surface 的 decoder 可以获得几乎相同的行为对象而完全不学习 z_effect，因此 latent invariant representation 的必要性尚未被证明。
children.external_required_action: Add a capacity-matched direct effect-signature baseline that receives exactly the same source-side probe signature, target schema, target capacity, calls, and tokens, but no latent contrastive/cycle objective. Also cost the source-side probe execution identically across methods. PASS only if z_effect improves fully held-out directed-pair fidelity beyond this baseline and the fixed canonical IR.
children.external_required_action_zh: 加入容量匹配的直接 effect-signature 基线：它获得完全相同的源侧 probe signature、目标 schema、目标容量、调用次数和 token，但不使用 latent contrastive/cycle objective。同时所有方法必须计入完全相同的源侧 probe 执行成本。只有 z_effect 在完整留出的有向 pair 上同时超过该基线和固定 canonical IR，才能 PASS。

title.zh: 随机微分配下一单位收益控制器

problem.zh: 多轮模型演化后，近期学习进展可能把因模型版本变化产生的新训练收益与任务本身的自然波动混为一谈，使课程持续投入已经饱和的任务或错过新失败边界。
problem.en: Across repeated model-evolution rounds, recent learning progress can confound version-induced changes in training return with ordinary task noise, causing curricula to keep funding saturated tasks or miss newly valuable failure boundaries.

changed_assumption.zh: 不再把观察到的 loss、成功率斜率或失败率变化当作某任务下一单位训练预算的收益；核心对象改为通过随机预算干预识别的、版本条件化的因果边际收益。
changed_assumption.en: Observed loss, success-rate slopes, or failure-rate changes are no longer treated as the return of the next unit of training. The learned object becomes version-conditioned causal marginal gain identified through randomized allocation interventions.

exact_mechanism.zh: 每轮训练预算中预留固定比例 epsilon 作为随机微分配：对候选任务族按已记录的非零探索概率随机增加一个微型训练块，其余预算由当前控制器分配。对每次微分配记录模型版本表示 v、任务族 k、分配概率 p、训练前后独立验证集指标差和回归指标。使用 inverse-propensity 或 doubly-robust 估计器学习 g(v,k)，即在版本 v 下把下一单位训练给任务 k 的因果效用及置信区间。下一轮只依据 g 的保守下界分配主要预算，同时保留固定回归锚点。训练完成后冻结 g，并将其直接用于另一条未参与拟合的模型版本序列。
exact_mechanism.en: Reserve a fixed epsilon fraction of every training round for randomized micro-allocations: candidate task families receive an extra micro-training block according to logged nonzero exploration probabilities, while the remaining budget follows the current controller. Each intervention logs model-version representation v, task family k, allocation propensity p, independent pre/post validation change, and regression metrics. An inverse-propensity or doubly robust estimator learns g(v,k), the causal utility and uncertainty of assigning the next training unit to task k at version v. The main budget is allocated using a conservative lower bound on g while fixed regression anchors are retained. After training, g is frozen and applied to a separate model-version stream.

learning_signal.zh: 具有已知随机分配概率的任务微训练干预，以及干预前后独立 held-out 能力指标和回归指标的差值。
learning_signal.en: Randomized task micro-training interventions with known assignment propensities and the resulting changes in independent held-out capability and regression metrics.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 对评测版本额外执行不提供给控制器的均匀随机微分配实验，用真实的下一训练块后 held-out 指标变化作为任务族因果收益排序真值。
independent_ground_truth.en: For evaluation versions, run additional uniformly randomized micro-allocations hidden from the controller and use the realized held-out change after the next training block as ground truth for causal task-return ranking.

simplest_baseline.zh: TSCL 风格控制器：在完全相同总训练预算和回归下限下，仅依据近期 held-out 学习进展斜率分配任务，不学习版本漂移或因果收益模型。
simplest_baseline.en: A TSCL-style controller using the identical total training budget and regression floor, reallocating tasks solely from recent held-out learning-progress slopes without a learned drift or causal-gain model.

decisive_pilot.zh: 使用一个可公开复现的小模型和 6 至 10 个任务族构造两条独立版本流，每个新版本通过固定的小规模 continued-training 或 adapter update 产生。第一条版本流学习 g，第二条完全冻结迁移。每轮都用相同训练 token。首先比较各方法预测“下一微训练块最值得给哪个任务”的 top-1/regret，再比较固定总预算后的宏平均能力与回归。决定性结果必须是在第二条版本流上，g 对随机干预真值的 next-unit regret 低于 TSCL、失败率和遗忘启发式，并转化为更高最终效用。
decisive_pilot.en: Use a publicly reproducible small model with 6-10 task families and construct two independent version streams via fixed small continued-training or adapter updates. Learn g only on the first stream and transfer it frozen to the second, with identical training tokens per round. First compare methods on regret for predicting which task should receive the next micro-block using randomized-intervention ground truth, then compare final macro capability and regression under the same total budget. The decisive result is lower next-unit regret than TSCL, failure-rate, and forgetting heuristics on the second stream, coupled with higher final utility.

stop_condition.zh: 如果因果收益估计在独立版本流上的下一单位收益预测不优于简单学习进展，或更准确的收益预测不能改善固定预算下的最终训练结果，则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if causal-gain estimates do not outperform simple learning progress in next-unit return prediction on the independent version stream, or if improved prediction fails to improve final training outcomes under a fixed budget.

what_is_inherited.zh: 继承多轮模型更新会使课程变陈旧、需要重新分配训练预算并保留回归锚点的问题。
what_is_inherited.en: It inherits the problem that curricula become stale across model updates and therefore require budget reallocation while retaining regression anchors.

material_change.zh: 父方案的观察式“边际学习进展+漂移”被替换为每轮真实随机预算干预得到的版本条件化因果 next-unit return，并要求在独立版本流中冻结迁移。
material_change.en: The parent's observational marginal-progress-plus-drift estimate is replaced by version-conditioned causal next-unit return identified from real randomized budget interventions, with mandatory frozen transfer to an independent version stream.

external_reviews.finding: Randomized micro-allocation and frozen transfer to an independent version stream materially improve the parent's observational learning-progress formulation. However, the declared strongest baseline is no longer adequate. Actor-Curator already formulates LLM post-training curriculum selection as a non-stationary bandit, directly optimizes expected policy improvement, maintains nonzero exploration, and uses importance-weighted unbiased feedback under partial observation. ([arXiv][9]) Earlier task-selection work also explicitly connects curriculum allocation with off-policy/counterfactual estimation. ([arXiv][10]) Consequently, an IPS/DR model of next-unit return is not distinguished by comparing only against TSCL-style learning-progress slopes. The surviving possibility is cross-version causal transport: whether a gain model fitted on randomized interventions in one version-generating process predicts true marginal returns in an independently generated frozen version stream better than a same-data contextual bandit or Actor-Curator-style policy.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 随机微分配以及冻结迁移到独立版本流，确实比父方案基于观察式 learning progress 的设计有实质改进。但当前声明的最强基线已经不足。Actor-Curator 已经把 LLM post-training 的课程选择建模为非平稳 bandit，直接优化期望 policy improvement，保持非零探索概率，并用 importance-weighted 的无偏反馈处理 partial observation。([arXiv][9]) 更早的 task-selection 工作也已经明确把课程预算分配与 off-policy/counterfactual estimation 联系起来。([arXiv][10]) 因此，仅用 TSCL 风格的 learning-progress slope 作比较，不能证明 IPS/DR next-unit return 模型的新颖必要性。真正可能保留下来的边界是跨版本因果迁移：在一条版本生成过程上由随机干预拟合的 gain model，能否在独立生成且冻结的版本流上，比使用相同数据的 contextual bandit 或 Actor-Curator 式方法更准确地预测真实边际收益。
external_reviews.required_action: Replace TSCL as the main simplification test with two matched baselines: (1) Actor-Curator-style policy-improvement bandit with the same exploration budget, and (2) a direct contextual bandit/response model trained on exactly the same randomized micro-allocation tuples and version representation. Make frozen transport across a held-out version-generating operator, not generic causal terminology, the central claim.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 将主要简化检验从 TSCL 改为两个严格匹配的基线：(1) 使用相同探索预算的 Actor-Curator 式 policy-improvement bandit；(2) 使用完全相同随机微分配 tuples 和版本表示训练的直接 contextual bandit/response model。核心主张应改成对完整留出的 version-generating operator 的冻结迁移，而不是泛化地强调“causal”。

closest_work: Actor-Curator: Co-adaptive Curriculum Learning via Policy-Improvement Bandits for RL Post-Training — non-stationary bandit curriculum optimized from policy-improvement feedback with importance-weighted exploration. ([arXiv][9])
Task Selection Policies for Multitask Learning — connects task allocation to off-policy evaluation and counterfactual estimation. ([arXiv][10])
Self-Evolving Curriculum for LLM Reasoning — formulates evolving curriculum selection as a non-stationary multi-armed bandit. ([OpenReview][11])
direct_collision.surviving_difference: Explicit randomized next-training-block interventions plus frozen prediction across a separately generated model-version stream could establish transportable marginal-gain estimation, which the online co-adaptive curricula do not establish.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Actor-Curator-style policy-improvement bandit and a version-conditioned contextual bandit using the exact same randomized micro-allocation data, propensities, version features, and total training tokens.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Generate training and evaluation version streams using disjoint update operators. Collect identical randomized micro-allocation data for the training stream, freeze every learned allocator, and evaluate next-unit regret against hidden uniform-randomized interventions in the second stream. The proposed estimator must beat both matched bandit baselines and translate that reduction into superior final utility at identical token budget.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if a direct same-data contextual bandit or Actor-Curator-style method matches next-unit regret on the held-out version stream, or if lower causal-return prediction error does not improve final fixed-budget training utility.
unknowns: Whether a compact version representation contains stable information that transports across genuinely different update operators.
Whether the cost of randomized micro-training blocks is large enough to erase the curriculum efficiency benefit.

title.zh: 类型契约保持的记忆迁移器

problem.zh: 结构化 agent 记忆在模型与 harness/tool-schema 同时替换后会失效：即使自然语言语义近似不变，前置条件可能不再可判定，程序中的工具调用可能类型不匹配，检索依赖可能断裂，执行约束也可能在新环境中失去一致性。
problem.en: Structured agent memories can fail under a joint model and harness/tool-schema swap even when their natural-language meaning appears preserved: preconditions may become unevaluable, tool calls may become ill-typed, retrieval dependencies may break, and execution constraints may no longer remain jointly consistent.

changed_assumption.zh: 不再假设成功的迁移主要是源资产到目标文本的条件生成；改为假设真正需要学习的是在环境变化后保持一组可机器检查的类型化关系不变量，文本只是该关系对象的一种序列化。
changed_assumption.en: Instead of assuming transfer is primarily conditional generation from a source asset to target text, assume that the learnable object is preservation of machine-checkable typed relational invariants after the environment changes, with text serving only as one serialization of that object.

exact_mechanism.zh: 先把每个持久记忆编译为一个类型化关系 IR：Precondition 节点声明其所读取的状态字段与谓词类型，Program 节点声明工具签名及输入输出类型，RetrievalEdge 声明被检索对象及其依赖类型，ExecutionConstraint 声明必须在程序前、后或全程成立的约束。给定源和目标 model+harness schema，迁移器不自由重写整段记忆，而是预测一组受限 IR 编辑：字段重绑定、工具签名替换、依赖边重定向和谓词重写。每个候选编辑必须通过静态类型检查、引用完整性检查和约束可满足性检查后才能重新序列化为目标记忆；非法候选直接拒绝。训练时使用相同 source/target traces 中能够恢复可执行目标资产的编辑序列作为监督，并额外惩罚破坏上述关系不变量的候选。
exact_mechanism.en: Compile each persistent memory into a typed relational IR: Precondition nodes declare the state fields and predicate types they consume; Program nodes declare tool signatures and input/output types; RetrievalEdge nodes declare referenced objects and dependency types; and ExecutionConstraint nodes declare conditions that must hold before, after, or throughout execution. Given source and target model+harness schemas, the translator does not freely rewrite the whole memory. It predicts a restricted set of IR edits: field rebinding, tool-signature substitution, dependency-edge redirection, and predicate rewriting. Every candidate edit must pass static type checking, reference-integrity checking, and constraint-satisfiability checking before it can be serialized into the target memory; invalid candidates are rejected. Training uses edit sequences recoverable from the same source/target traces that yield executable target assets, with additional loss on candidates that violate these relational invariants.

children.update_surface: persisted typed relational memory IR plus its target-bound serialized executable asset

learning_signal.zh: 监督信号由同预算 source/target 执行轨迹中恢复出的目标 IR 编辑组成；主损失预测正确编辑操作与绑定，辅助信号仅来自确定性的类型错误、悬空 retrieval edge、工具签名冲突和约束不可满足事件。最终成功率不作为唯一或必要的结构监督。
learning_signal.en: Supervision consists of target IR edits recovered from equal-budget source/target execution traces. The primary loss predicts the correct edit operations and bindings; auxiliary signals come only from deterministic type errors, dangling retrieval edges, tool-signature conflicts, and unsatisfied constraints. End-task success is neither the sole nor a required source of structural supervision.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 独立真值由目标 harness 的真实工具 schema、环境状态字段定义以及独立执行器产生，而不是由迁移模型或目标 LLM 自评。对每个迁移资产，离线检查器验证类型正确性、引用闭合与约束一致性；随后在冻结目标模型上执行，记录工具调用是否合法以及预条件和后置条件是否由环境真实状态满足。
independent_ground_truth.en: Independent ground truth comes from the target harness's actual tool schemas, environment state definitions, and an external executor rather than judgments from the translator or target LLM. For every transferred asset, an offline checker verifies typing, reference closure, and constraint consistency; the asset is then executed with the frozen target model, while legality of tool calls and satisfaction of pre/postconditions are determined from true environment state.

simplest_baseline.zh: 最强的容量匹配简化基线是 MASA 式 model-conditioned 整体重写器：使用与本方法完全相同的 source/target 资产对、执行轨迹、模型调用、token、训练步数和参数预算，但将整个结构化记忆作为单一序列输入输出，不提供类型节点、关系边、受限编辑或不变量检查。另报告 PromptBridge 式映射与 target-model rewrite-from-scratch，二者也严格共享相同观测与优化预算。
simplest_baseline.en: The strongest capacity-matched simpler baseline is a MASA-style model-conditioned monolithic rewriter trained with exactly the same source/target asset pairs, execution traces, model calls, tokens, optimization steps, and parameter budget, but receiving and emitting each structured memory as a single serialization with no typed nodes, relational edges, restricted edits, or invariant checks. PromptBridge-style mapping and target-model rewrite-from-scratch are also reported under exactly the same observations and optimization budget.

decisive_pilot.zh: P0 构造约 80–120 个公开 agent/tool 任务的联合迁移对，并刻意只选择会改变结构关系的 swap：工具重命名并改变参数类型、状态字段拆分/合并、程序输出格式变化、检索键重构。冻结一个未见过的目标模型家族和至少一个未见 harness schema。比较本方法与容量匹配整体重写器，在完全相同预算下测量：(1) 全部类型化不变量同时保持率，(2) 首次执行前静态合法率，(3) 冻结目标上的可执行任务成功率。决定性证据不是平均成功率的小幅提高，而是本方法在关系发生变化的 held-out cases 上显著降低“任务偶尔成功但资产结构已失真”的比例，并在 invariant-preservation 上明显超过整体重写器。如果去掉受限 IR 编辑和检查器后优势消失，则支持核心机制而非模型容量解释。
decisive_pilot.en: For P0, build roughly 80–120 joint transfer pairs from public agent/tool tasks, deliberately selecting swaps that alter structural relations: tool renaming with argument-type changes, state-field splits/merges, program-output-format changes, and retrieval-key restructuring. Freeze one unseen target model family and at least one unseen harness schema. Under identical budgets, compare the method with the capacity-matched monolithic rewriter on (1) joint preservation of all typed invariants, (2) static legality before first execution, and (3) executable task success with the frozen target. The decisive evidence is not a small gain in mean success, but a substantial reduction on held-out relation-changing cases where a task can occasionally succeed despite a structurally corrupted asset, together with a clear invariant-preservation advantage over monolithic rewriting. If the advantage disappears when restricted IR edits and checking are removed, the result supports the proposed mechanism rather than extra capacity.

stop_condition.zh: 若在至少两种 joint model+harness swap 上，容量匹配整体重写器与本方法的 joint invariant-preservation 差异小于 5 个百分点，或本方法的结构优势不能转化为更高的首次合法执行率，则停止该方向；这说明显式类型分解与关系保持并未提供超越整体重写的必要机制。
stop_condition.en: Stop if, across at least two joint model+harness swaps, the capacity-matched monolithic rewriter is within 5 percentage points of the method on joint invariant preservation, or if the structural advantage does not translate into a higher first-attempt legal-execution rate. That outcome would indicate that explicit typing and relation preservation are not a necessary mechanism beyond monolithic rewriting.

what_is_inherited.zh: 继承父方案中已经成立的真实问题：模型替换会破坏持久技能/记忆资产，且应在未见模型家族上冻结评测；同时保留结构化资产而非普通 prompt 作为迁移对象。还继承 reviewer 指出的可辩护边界：前置条件、可执行程序、检索拓扑与执行约束需要联合保持。
what_is_inherited.en: The child inherits the established problem that model swaps can break persistent skill/memory assets and that evaluation should freeze an unseen model family. It also retains structured assets, rather than ordinary prompts, as the transfer object, and preserves the reviewer's defensible boundary: preconditions, executable programs, retrieval topology, and execution constraints must remain jointly valid.

material_change.zh: 父方案学习的是泛化的组件级翻译与重组；子方案把学习对象改成了具有显式类型契约的关系 IR，并把迁移限制为可检查的结构编辑，训练和主评测直接针对不变量保持。这样即使整体重写器获得完全相同的数据和容量，它也无法通过文本相似或偶然任务成功替代核心判据。
material_change.en: The parent learned generic component-level translation and recomposition. The child instead changes the learned object to an explicitly typed relational IR and restricts transfer to checkable structural edits, with training and primary evaluation directly targeting invariant preservation. Therefore, even a monolithic rewriter with identical data and capacity cannot satisfy the central criterion merely through textual similarity or accidental task success.

external_reviews.finding: The child is a material improvement: it changes the learned object from unrestricted text rewriting to typed relational edits over preconditions, programs, retrieval dependencies, and execution constraints. This boundary is plausible despite adjacent work: MemIR already demonstrates typed intermediate representations for agent memory, but focuses on provenance/source-role correctness rather than model+harness migration; MASA adapts procedural skills across models; and software-migration systems such as SPELL distill reusable structured transformations for API migration. ([arXiv][15]) The remaining flaw is baseline asymmetry. title.zh: 零锚点评价器状态外推器

problem.zh: Actor 与 evaluator 持续共同演化时，新 evaluator 版本可能产生此前未出现的版本配对偏差，而部署时通常无法立即获得该新版本的人工 anchor 标签。
problem.en: As actors and evaluators co-evolve, a new evaluator version can induce previously unseen version-pair biases, while human anchor labels for that new evaluator are often unavailable at deployment.

changed_assumption.zh: 不再依赖未来 evaluator 的少量真实标签进行校准，而是假设 evaluator 在无标签探针上的可观测行为指纹携带其潜在版本状态；该状态的时间动力学可从历史版本学习并外推到完全零 anchor 的未来版本。
changed_assumption.en: Remove reliance on a few ground-truth labels from the future evaluator. Instead assume that observable responses to unlabeled diagnostic probes encode a latent evaluator-version state whose temporal dynamics can be learned from historical versions and extrapolated to a truly zero-anchor future version.

exact_mechanism.zh: 为每个历史 evaluator 在固定无标签 probe bank 上采集 logits、置信度、长度偏好、位置翻转敏感性和自一致性等 fingerprint。编码器将 fingerprint 映射到低维状态 z_t，并用按时间顺序训练的状态转移模型预测 z_{t+1}。历史 actor×evaluator 交叉评分仅用于学习从 actor 描述与 z_t 到偏差残差的条件修正头。测试时新 evaluator 只能运行无标签 probe；禁止读取该版本的任何人工或任务真值标签，生成 z_new 后直接修正其评分。
exact_mechanism.en: For each historical evaluator, collect a fingerprint on a fixed unlabeled probe bank, including logits, confidence, length preference, position-flip sensitivity, and self-consistency. An encoder maps the fingerprint to a low-dimensional state z_t, and a chronologically trained transition model predicts the next-state manifold. Historical actor-by-evaluator crossed scores train a conditional correction head from actor descriptors and z_t to score bias. At test time the new evaluator may only answer unlabeled probes; no human or task labels from that version are allowed, and its inferred z_new directly conditions score correction.

children.update_surface: persistent latent evaluator-version state transition model and frozen bias-correction head

learning_signal.zh: 状态表示由历史无标签 fingerprint 的时间预测和重构损失学习；偏差头使用仅来自历史版本的独立人工/任务真值与 evaluator 分数残差训练。未来版本标签严格不进入任何更新。
learning_signal.en: The state representation is learned from temporal prediction and reconstruction of historical unlabeled fingerprints; the bias head is trained on evaluator residuals against independent human/task ground truth from historical versions only. Labels from the future version are strictly excluded from all updates.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 评价真值由在模型训练完成后才揭示的人工偏好、多评审共识或可程序验证任务结果给出；这些标签仅用于最终评估 held-out evaluator version，而不参与其状态估计。
independent_ground_truth.en: Ground truth consists of human preferences, multi-rater consensus, or programmatically verified task outcomes revealed only after model training; these labels are used solely to evaluate the held-out evaluator version and never to infer its state.

simplest_baseline.zh: 容量匹配的静态 pooled calibration head，输入完全相同的 actor descriptor、新 evaluator 无标签 fingerprint、版本元数据和 recency，但把这些量当作普通协变量，不学习显式时间状态转移或跨版本外推算子。
simplest_baseline.en: A capacity-matched pooled static calibration head receiving exactly the same actor descriptors, new-evaluator unlabeled fingerprint, version metadata, and recency as ordinary covariates, but with no explicit temporal latent-state transition or cross-version extrapolation operator.

decisive_pilot.zh: 按发布时间排序至少 5 个 evaluator checkpoint，以最后一个版本做完全 zero-anchor 测试。训练阶段仅允许前序版本真值；测试阶段两方法都可访问最后版本同一套无标签 probes。比较其对最后版本 actor×evaluator 配对偏差的 MAE、排序反转率和人类一致性恢复。再逐步删除时间转移，仅保留同维 fingerprint encoder，验证收益来自历史动力学而非更多参数。
decisive_pilot.en: Chronologically order at least five evaluator checkpoints and hold out the final version under a strict zero-anchor protocol. Training may use ground truth only from earlier versions; at test time both methods access the identical unlabeled probe set from the final evaluator. Compare MAE of actor-evaluator pair bias, ranking-flip rate, and recovery of agreement with humans. Ablate the temporal transition while retaining an equal-dimensional fingerprint encoder to test whether gains arise from longitudinal dynamics rather than parameter count.

stop_condition.zh: 若在两个以上 held-out chronological splits 上，显式状态转移模型不能持续优于使用完全相同无标签 fingerprint 的静态校准器，或其优势在去掉版本时间顺序后仍保持，则停止“纵向外推”主张并退化为 fingerprint-based calibration。
stop_condition.en: Stop the longitudinal-extrapolation claim if the explicit state-transition model fails to consistently outperform the static calibrator with identical unlabeled fingerprints on at least two chronological held-out splits, or if its advantage persists after destroying version chronology; then reduce the method to fingerprint-based calibration.

what_is_inherited.zh: 继承父方案的 actor-version × evaluator-version 交叉视角、独立真值锚定和对版本配对特异偏差进行修正的目标。
what_is_inherited.en: Inherits the crossed actor-version by evaluator-version perspective, independent ground-truth anchoring, and the goal of correcting version-pair-specific bias.

material_change.zh: 父方案依赖 anchor 后拟合交互残差；子方案把不可约对象改为可在未来标签出现前估计的 evaluator 潜在版本状态及其时间转移，并用严格 zero-anchor chronological extrapolation 检验其是否提供静态校准无法获得的信息。
material_change.en: The parent fit interaction residuals around anchors; the child makes the irreducible object an evaluator latent version state and temporal transition estimable before any future labels exist, tested by strict zero-anchor chronological extrapolation against a static calibrator with identical observables.

external_reviews.finding: This is a material repair rather than a rename: it removes the parent's dependence on labels from the future evaluator and turns evaluator replacement into a strict zero-anchor chronological generalization problem. Evaluator replacement is a real measurement-validity failure mode: recent work shows that changing the judge can change rankings and bias behavior even with fixed candidate responses. ([arXiv][1]) The held-out ground truth is also independent because future-version human/task labels are revealed only for final evaluation. However, the proposed temporal operator is not yet shown to be irreducible. As written, the new evaluator's current unlabeled fingerprint is encoded into z_new and directly drives the correction head; the transition model mainly supplies a temporal prediction/manifold objective. A capacity-matched direct predictor given the identical current fingerprint, complete ordered historical fingerprints, timestamps/recency, actor descriptors, and historical labels could potentially learn the same future residual without an explicit latent state transition. The proposed static pooled baseline is therefore too weak. This matters because existing work already supplies label-free judge debiasing at inference time, covariate-based human-judge calibration, and external bias-correction modules, although none of the sources found directly implements zero-anchor chronological evaluator-state extrapolation. CalibraEval is label-free but targets selection bias rather than version dynamics; Bridge models systematic human-LLM discrepancies using covariates but is fitted with human judgments; RBD learns an external correction module for known judge biases. ([ACL Anthology][2]) ([arXiv][3]) ([NeurIPS Proceedings][4])
external_reviews.finding_zh: 这是实质性修复而不是改名：它真正去掉了父方案对未来 evaluator 标签的依赖，并把 evaluator 更换问题改成严格的 zero-anchor 时间外推问题。近期研究已经证明 evaluator 更换本身会导致固定候选输出的测量结果、排序和偏差行为发生变化，因此问题是真实的。([arXiv][1]) 独立真值设计也成立，因为未来版本的人类/任务真值只在最终评估时揭示，不参与状态估计。但当前仍不能 PASS，因为“时间状态转移”尚未成为不可约机制。按现有描述，新 evaluator 的当前无标签 fingerprint 被编码为 z_new 后直接输入修正头；状态转移更像训练时的时间预测/流形正则。因此，一个容量匹配、使用完全相同数据的直接预测器——同时输入当前 fingerprint、完整有序历史 fingerprint、时间戳/recency、actor descriptor 和历史标签——可能无需显式 latent transition 就复现收益。当前仅比较 static pooled calibrator 的 baseline 太弱。已有工作已经覆盖无标签 judge 去偏、基于协变量的人类-judge 校准以及外部 bias correction，但本次检索未发现与“未来 evaluator 零标签 + 按版本时间顺序外推 latent state”完全相同的方案：CalibraEval 是无标签但主要修复 selection bias；Bridge 用协变量建模人类与 LLM judge 偏差但依赖历史人类判断；RBD 是针对已知 bias 类型训练的外部修正模块。([ACL Anthology][2]) ([arXiv][3]) ([NeurIPS Proceedings][4])
external_reviews.required_action: Make the chronological operator causally necessary and test it against a genuinely equivalent non-state alternative. Specify an explicit inference equation, for example a state-space filter in which the previous inferred state predicts a prior for z_new and the new fingerprint supplies an observation update; clarify exactly where the transition affects the corrected score. Then replace the weak static-only control with a capacity- and budget-matched direct history-aware predictor that receives the same ordered fingerprint history, current fingerprint, timestamps, actor descriptors, and historical supervision but predicts the future evaluator residual directly with no latent transition. Use rolling-origin held-out evaluator versions and require the transition method to beat both the current-fingerprint static model and this history-aware direct predictor; chronology permutation must destroy the claimed advantage.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 必须让时间算子在推理路径中具有因果必要性，并与真正等价的非状态模型比较。首先写清楚明确的推理方程，例如使用 state-space filter：上一版本状态先通过 transition 产生 z_new 的先验，新 evaluator fingerprint 再作为 observation 更新状态，并明确 transition 最终在哪一步影响校正分数。其次，把目前过弱的 static-only baseline 替换为容量和预算匹配的 history-aware direct predictor：它可获得完全相同的有序历史 fingerprint、当前 fingerprint、时间戳、actor descriptor 与历史监督，但不建立 latent transition，直接预测未来 evaluator residual。采用 rolling-origin 的多个未来版本测试；只有 transition 方法同时超过当前 fingerprint 的静态模型和 history-aware direct predictor，并且打乱版本顺序后优势消失，才能保留“纵向状态外推”主张。

closest_work: When the Judge Changes, So Does the Measurement: Auditing LLM-as-Judge Reliability (arXiv:2607.08535) — directly establishes evaluator-replacement ambiguity and version-dependent judge reliability, but audits rather than learns a zero-anchor longitudinal correction operator. ([arXiv][1])

Bridging Human and LLM Judgments: Understanding and Narrowing the Gap — models systematic human-LLM judgment discrepancies using covariates and improves human agreement, but does not perform chronological zero-anchor extrapolation to an unseen evaluator version. ([arXiv][3])

CalibraEval: Calibrating Prediction Distribution to Mitigate Selection Bias in LLMs-as-Judges — provides label-free inference-time debiasing, but targets position/selection bias through prediction-distribution calibration rather than evaluator-version dynamics. ([ACL Anthology][2])

Any Large Language Model Can Be a Reliable Judge: Debiasing with a Reasoning-based Bias Detector — learns an external bias detector/corrector applicable across evaluators, but relies on supervised bias construction and does not extrapolate a latent evaluator state over release chronology. ([NeurIPS Proceedings][4])

Validating LLM-as-a-Judge Systems in the Absence of Gold Labels — studies judge validation when per-item gold labels are unavailable, but its object is validation rather than correction of a newly released evaluator from longitudinal fingerprints. ([arXiv][5])
direct_collision.surviving_difference: No directly colliding source found implements the full combination of crossed actor-by-evaluator historical supervision, unlabeled diagnostic fingerprints for a completely unseen evaluator version, an explicitly learned chronological evaluator-state transition, zero future-version anchors, and frozen downstream bias correction. The surviving novelty is therefore the longitudinal zero-anchor transition operator, conditional on proving that chronology adds information unavailable to equally budgeted direct fingerprint/history regression.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A capacity-matched history-aware direct residual predictor using the identical ordered historical fingerprints, current-version unlabeled fingerprint, timestamps/recency, actor descriptors, historical human/task residual labels, probe budget, parameter count, and training compute, but mapping these observables directly to actor-by-evaluator bias without an explicit latent state transition. Include current-fingerprint-only calibration and last-version/recency regression as simpler controls, plus CalibraEval or RBD where their bias assumptions apply.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Use substantially more than a single five-checkpoint split if possible: construct at least 8 chronologically ordered evaluator checkpoints/releases, preferably with two independent release sequences or model families, and perform rolling-origin evaluation on at least the final three versions. For each held-out version, prohibit all of its human/task labels during training and state inference; every method receives exactly the same unlabeled probe responses and historical supervision. Compare (A) the explicit transition/filter, (B) current-fingerprint static calibration, (C) the capacity-matched history-aware direct predictor, and (D) time/last-version controls. Measure held-out residual MAE, pairwise ranking flips relative to independent human/task truth, and human-agreement recovery. Add equal-dimensional encoder ablations, shuffled chronology, reversed chronology, and fingerprint-feature ablations. A longitudinal claim is supported only if A consistently beats C as well as B, with paired uncertainty excluding a practically negligible effect, and the A advantage collapses when chronology is destroyed.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop the longitudinal-state claim if the explicit transition fails to outperform the capacity-matched history-aware direct predictor on at least two of three rolling future-version holdouts, if the pooled paired advantage is indistinguishable from zero or practically negligible, if chronology permutation/reversal preserves the gain, or if z_new inferred without the transition performs equivalently. In those cases retain only the narrower zero-anchor fingerprint-calibration contribution. Also stop if future-version fingerprint shift is so discontinuous that historical dynamics have no predictive value.
unknowns: Whether real evaluator release trajectories are sufficiently smooth or recurrent for a learned transition to extrapolate rather than merely interpolate; released API models can change discontinuously, and recent evaluator-replacement evidence shows non-monotone adjacent behavior. ([arXiv][1])
Whether logits or comparable confidence signals are available for the intended closed-source evaluators; the fingerprint definition may need an API-agnostic subset based only on observable outputs.
Whether a fixed probe bank remains informative for later evaluator versions rather than becoming stale, contaminated, or easy to overfit.
Whether the latent state is identifiable separately from model-family identity, release metadata, domain shift, prompt changes, and actor-distribution drift.
Whether enough historical actor-by-evaluator crossed human/task labels exist to estimate version-pair residuals without the correction head simply learning actor or evaluator identity.

Whether five evaluator checkpoints, as originally proposed, provide enough independent temporal transitions to distinguish genuine dynamics from ordinary regression; a larger rolling-origin panel is preferable.

Whether human preference disagreement makes residual MAE an appropriate primary target in subjective domains; programmatically verifiable tasks or multi-rater uncertainty-aware targets should be included where possible.
